google.author: Sharon ngan
google.text:
We’ve just been Thaitastic for our anniversary dinner. Staff were helpful to recommend Thai dishes to us. We had prawn crackers, Satay skewers, Tom Yum soup, massamen curry with beef and duck in tamarind sauce.

We love the curry and the duck which were delicious x the tamarind sauce was tangy and perfect with pan-fried duck.

I have tried the Tom Yum soup which was nice and mild spicy. It’s quite strange to have mushroom in this soup.

Also, I wish if the shop could provide brown prawn crackers. As the white crackers are more Chinese flavour than Thai. I would say the brown one is more authentic.

Please reserve a table in advance as it was quite busy.

Overall the restaurant is brilliant and beautiful with bamboo and Thai floral decoration.

I would recommend it to all of you.

google.author: Neil Thorpe
google.text: A real authentic Thai restaurant. Food was exceptional and spot on for anyone who knows what real Thai food is. My wife is Thai and completelt agreed how good the food was. Owner / Head chef was very pleasant and couldn't offer a better service for us, made us welcome and we felt like valued customers. Will definitely be back, Would highly recommend.

google.author: Stephen Leung
google.text:
After a long walk up the Orm we were starving .. !!! Stumbled on this little Thai restaurant and we were not disappointed.

The Tong Yum Soup was amazing, zesty and spicy at the same time, definitely have this.  We had a mixture of chicken and prawn.  The prawn curry was excellent, the prawns were snappy and plump - a sign of being fresh, not mushy and soft.  The skewers were also of the same standard, no stringy chicken here.

It was a very nice and enjoyable experience, the staff courteous and accommodating to our needs.  If we return to Llandudno again we would not hesitate to try this again.  It's good to see local business' rather chains on the high street.

google.author: Giuseppe
google.text:
I had an amazing experience at Thaitastic last night. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch.
Lovely welcome by the Chef. Who was very attentive and made excellent recommendations.
Served quickly and pleasantly.
The ambiance was perfect for a relaxing evening out. I can't wait to come back!
Thank you Thaitastic. I highly recommend your restaurant.

google.author: Kristy Li
google.text:
The great thing about this restaurant is that it’s dog friendly. But, we were disappointed that the quality of food was subpar.

The chicken satay was cold when served and was not grilled like how it should be. There’s barely any shrimp or vegetables in the Tom Yum.

The dishes were seasoned, however the quality of food could have been better for the price we paid.

name: Chatsworth House Hotel

google.author: Barbara Garside
google.text:
Room small but adequate and clean, service with a smile every time,
We had a 4 day stay and found it worth every penny.
The staff and food was excellent.
Location is great . Train station not far if you want to travel further afield and plenty of shopping to be had.

google.author: Tracy Parkinson
google.text: The staff were always their happy to help very polite.Meals were great thanks chef.The Hotel is very clean and tidy.Will come back again The pool is amazing

google.author: Charlotte Reynard
google.text: Had a lovely weekend with my family, we didn't want to go home we wanted to say a bit longer, the staff were friendly, the food was amazing and had great view of the sea. Thank you very much

google.author: It.Is. Paty
google.text:
This is such a lovely hotel but it needs a serious considerations and upgrades. With it's prime location, this hotel could easily become a 5 ⭐ hotel and has it's former glory.

Generally, the hotel fits for purpose and is rather a good value.
Lovely staff and

google.author: Amanda Branigan
google.text: Lovely staff ,  everything was really nice , but the bedroom was so small ,  it really made my stay uncomfortable, I purposely booked direct with the hotel ( and paid more than on booking sites) so I could explain while booking that due to my sons autism , please may we have a moderate size room at the least as he needs room to pace up and down, the lady in n reception was lovely,but I couldn't face going back down to reception to explain

description: Simple rooms, some with sea views, in a hotel offering indoor heated pools & a genteel restaurant.

name: New Loretta Hotel

google.author: Amy Alexander
google.text: We stayed here for 5 days as part of a coach trip, you really cant fault the place. The staff are amazing they cant do enough for you. The food is lovely especially the home made soups. Drinks are reasonably priced. The entertainment on an evening is also good. Its clean and its tidy. Our room was on the small size but you're only sleeping in it. The only thing I can grumble about is its like a sauna i dont think I've been in a hotel as hot. I'll just know for next time to pack my fan 🤣 it's a lovely place to stay and we will return.

google.author: rose foster
google.text:
Stayed for 2 nights.
Great hotel and very affordable. Food lovely, staff great and hardworking. Rooms very clean. Entertainment each night who were very good and had a good sense of humour. We had great nights.
Five minutes from the coast and pier and Llandudno itself is beautiful.
Would definitely stay again.

google.author: Emma Mayers
google.text: Hotel was clean, rooms was well equipped although could do with updating.  We stayed for 3 nights upon arrival we was welcomed and told what time meals was and which restaurant to use. 5.45 1st night & 6pm the following nights we was sat at a table and told that was where we had to sit for each meal (breakfast 8am-9am  and tea 6pm-7pm ) we had to share our table with another person which was not a problem, Breakfast was a standard cooked breakfast or continental.  The toaster was very slow.  We had a menu to chose from each morning for our evening meal and leave it on the table.  Each evening meal was a very small change from the night before we had a chicken dinner (Fri) turkey dinner (Sat) & a pork dinner (Sun) food was ok.  Nothing much to do until the entertainment started at 7.30pm 1st bingo then a singer which only 1 night we stayed up for as we were exhausted but sounded great upstairs wasn't that loud upstairs but you could hear it we was on the 1st floor. The only thing that let it down really was the horrible smell in the one part of the bar that would wonder through evey now and again.  We guessed that the men's toilets were leaking up above the bar and when the the flush was pulled that's when the smell would appear again as the smell was in the same area  as the toilets up above.  The 4 free drinks each a night was a nice bonus though.  I would come back as it was a good location only a 5 min walk to the town and 10 min walk to the train station, staff was friendly and helpful.  Towels & soap was supplied along with tea, coffee etc refilled everyday

google.author: Bev King
google.text:
Stay 6th - 9th Feb 2026 Caledonian trip.
The Hotel: The New Loretta. "All the staff, reception, bar, restaurant & housekeeping, were so professional & organised from checking in to checking out. Nothing was a problem for them & everything done with a cheery smile.
We had requested a ground floor twin with a walk in shower as we both have mobility & health issues & that is exactly what we got. A ground floor room that was clean, lovely & warm, well decorated & yes a lovely double walk in shower. The room was cleaned daily  & any used items replenished ( tea, coffee milk etc)
Meals: we were allocated a table for the duration of our stay (great idea), which avoids  queues at mealtimes.  Breakfast plentiful,  cereal, fruit juice, toast & a good selection of hot food ( self serve)
Evening meal offered a choice of 3 starters, main courses & desserts. Orders were taken at breakfast ready for the evening. The food was superb, hot ,tasty & plentiful & those with dietary needs appeared to be well accomodated.
Entertainment: Friday we had a male singer & a couple of games of bingo. Really enjoyable & a good singalong & boogie had by all.
Saturday " I'll come back to"
Sunday : Lady singer & bingo.  A great night, we'd of paid extra to listen to her, a brilliant end to our trip.
Excursions: The weather wasn't brilliant, but hey ho it was February in Wales. Interesting trips out, do them if you can. Sundays was a leisure day, the hotel is 5 mins walk to the seafront with its lovely flat promenade ,shops & cafes etc. Good for anyone with mobility issues.
Downer :🤬  The "entertainer" Jeff Page on the Saturday night. I'll use entertainer loosely as he was nothing more than a poor man's karaoke singer. He was particularly rude & obnoxious to another lady guest, who done nothing other than enjoy herself the night before, encouraging others to dance & join in. This so called professional, had no talent,  no people skills & a severe case of little man syndrome, as he wouldn't let the matter drop, even approaching the guests table & annoying those sat close by. His behaviour was disgusting. Other guests also pointed out that when he did the bingo,the pay out that evening was a lot less than the other 2 evenings,  make your own conclusions on that one. The hotel really should look at replacing him with someone more professional.
Overall: A fabulous holiday, people from all over the North East  Yorkshie etc were all sociable& chatty with each other, making an effort to include all, it was pleasant & enjoyable.
We would recommend this trip 100 % and will certainly be back.
5* to both Caledonian & The New Loretta & thank you.

google.author: Sharon Nicholls
google.text:
WOW! From stepping into the Hotel foyer....the vibe was AMAZING! It was a Turkey and tinsel  break, so quality Christmas trees were around, piped Christmas music it looked fantastc, already It was evedent to see this was a well kept hotel.....SPOTLESS!
Having travelled with Caledonia coaches from HULL, on the 3/11/25 we arrived early, so naturally the rooms were not quite ready, complimentary mince pies were given, and with 20 mins our rooms were ready!
Now here were this hotel was on another level....THE STAFF! So friendly, warm, and proffesional, my room was a single room which was SPOTLESS- FAULTLESS! spacious for single room, warm and inviting, bedding beautifully crisp and clean.
The bar area/ and drinks / deco/ music....bang on.
It was nearly tea- time, and the masses gathered, everything was handled with great presion! Calm, and  smiles, our coach driver from Hull gave us our choices  of food before
we arrived , We chose Cod in parsley sauce! and it was tasty, hot, with plenty of veg, Faultless, Tomatoe soup as my chosen starter was wholesome and tasty, followed by my chosen strawberry desert.
Fortunately for the HULL coach , our driver asked us our choice/
preferences  on route which were re- layed back to Kitchen...I believe other coachs didn't do this! However the kitchen / weighting staff stepped up and managed the whole operation PERFECTLY! Effortlessly! All staff at this splendid hotel, are a CREDIT YO THE CATERING AND HOSPITALITY INDUSTRY! I've travelled all over! and this hotel and its TEAM.... SIMPLY THE BEST. your hard work is, was appreciated. RESPECT to ALL.

description: Townhouse-style choice with free Wi-Fi, plus a restaurant, a bar and a bright conservatory.

name: Blue Elephant

google.author: Paige Mitchell
google.text: Had a brilliant meal this evening at Blue Elephant. The manager was very accommodating for our vegan guest. All the food was fresh and tasted incredible. The staff were very kind too. This was our second meal here. We will definitely be back again. 😊

google.author: Karen Powell
google.text:
First visit and the food was excellent
Delicious and full of flavour
Service was excellent
Definitely recommended

google.author: simran verma
google.text:
We visited Blue Elephant Indian Restaurant while in Llandudno to explore the city and celebrate my friend’s birthday. We were genuinely looking forward to making the evening special, but the experience was extremely disappointing.
After being seated, we informed the waiter that it was her birthday. Despite clearly mentioning this, there was no acknowledgement or effort made to recognise the occasion. The staff remained inattentive, and it felt as though our table was being ignored throughout the evening.
The food itself did not meet expectations. We chose this restaurant hoping for an authentic Indian dining experience; however, the dishes lacked depth of flavour and proper preparation. Overall, the quality was underwhelming and did not reflect what was advertised.
More concerning, after eating the meal, my friend began experiencing severe stomach pain, which we believe was due to the poor quality of the food. This not only ruined her birthday celebration but also raised serious concerns about food standards.
What should have been a joyful evening turned into a distressing and disappointing experience. Based on this visit, I would not recommend this restaurant, particularly for anyone planning a special occasion.

google.author: Sangeeta Israni
google.text:
We were disappointed with our experience at Blue Elephant, Llandudno. The manager's behaviour was pompous and arrogant, being extremely disrespectful and condescending in his communication when asked about the menu. What's more concerning is the blatant racial discrimination we witnessed, with preferential treatment given to certain customers.

The food was also subpar, with issues like half-missing papadums,  mint dip made of actual mints (mouth freshner’s)mixed in yoghurt, stale chicken kababs, and chewy half-cooked naan.

It's absolutely appalling that Blue Elephant masquerades Bangladeshi cuisine as Indian, yet shamelessly treats Indian customers with disdain. The blatant racial discrimination and false claims are unacceptable, and we strongly object to their business practices.

My review is for all fair minded people who would not like to patronise such establishments promoting racial discrimination, especially given that we had some memorable interactions with the natives who were humble, sporting and kind-hearted.

google.author: Tinkerbelle22
google.text: First time eating here and can’t fault it. Staff are welcoming and very polite. Food is absolutely delicious, we had poppadoms and chutneys while waiting for our sharing platter to start which I highly recommend, followed up by a lamb biriani, wow!! the lamb literally fell apart and was super tasty. My other half had Benghal Handi Special as recommended by one of the staff and he was also super impressed with how delicious it was. Would highly recommend a visit and great value for money

description: Unpretentious first-floor curry house with bright decor dishing up Bangladeshi and Indian staples.

google.author: Dest Iny
google.text: Been 3 times. First time, sat outside, due to having dogs. We shared and had lamb kofta, red onion tart, parfait, belly bites, crab cakes, cheesy garlic bread and I drank a good few Cherry Bakewell cocktails, dessert was nice. No where else did food like this. Food was outstanding, full of flavour.  Staff great, 10/10. Same again but sat inside. 3rd time Have gone back and menu changed and for me, the menu is no different than other places. Tried doing a variety but wasn't the same, also staff were different. We had to grab their attention several times. We left and went to get dessert else where, as we weren't offered any. Shame, great location. I will check back in winter to see what their menu is.

google.author: Josh Roberts
google.text: I've had roast dinners from here before and they have been amazing, but today's roast turkey Christmas dinner was fantastic!! The food tasted wonderful and it was a great portion size. Will definitely be coming back for Christmas dinner next year!

google.author: Connie Culmer
google.text: This is our second visit to Llandudno and our second visit to The Abode, the service has been absolutely wonderful and the food is outstanding. We will make sure we visit here every time we visit Llandudno. An absolute gem 💎

google.author: Phil Knight
google.text: The best Pie ive ever had, the picture doesnt do it any justice. Ive not tried every place in Llandudno, but Ive been to a lot and this is my new No.1 place 🙏 5*

google.author: Stephanie Black
google.text:
We had the most wonderful experience at The Abode Llandudno! From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and so accommodating—especially with our prams, which made a huge difference and instantly made us feel at ease.

Now, let’s talk about the food… the slow roast belly pork was nothing short of phenomenal — perfectly cooked, melt-in-your-mouth tender with a crispy crackling that was absolutely divine. Easily one of the best dishes we’ve had in a long time!

The atmosphere was warm and relaxed, making it the perfect spot for a casual lunch or a special treat. Thank you to the lovely team for making our visit so enjoyable — we’ll definitely be back! Highly recommend!

google.author: Carmen Martin
google.text: The five star rating is fully deserved on all counts. What an amazing place! So different to anything else we've been to for years. The staff were considerate without being pushy, efficient without being hurried. Interior decor was very Vivienne Westwood without being draggy, exterior was chic and quirky. The food! I had the Smashed Avocado Brunch with extra crispy bacon and I kid you not, I would drive the hour from home for the bacon alone. He had the breakfast, hold the mushrooms and tomatoes,  sourdough toast, latte x 2. Excellent. They also have a full vegan menu and gluten free menu. Will be back as soon as possible for milkshakes, smoothies, cakes etc.etc...

google.author: Simon
google.text: Visit this chain quite alot. Different locations.  Very dog friendly that's perfect for us. Can't go wrong really decent food decent service really causel bit hip at the same time. Overall great spot and will visit again. This site had great service aswell.

google.author: David Rees
google.text:
We enjoyed a reasonably good meal here at lunchtime in Feb 26.
The food quality was good, tasty and filling.
The menu is fairly extensive and they also have a separate Gluten Free menu with is also very good. They take a lot of care to ensure they cater for alergies/food intolerance.
The Ormo Loungs is also dog friendly (unlike Witherspoons across the road).
The Ormo Lounge doesn't appear to take bookings ... just turn up.

google.author: Anas Mahmood
google.text: This place is simply beautiful and is a wonderful and clean environment to dine in. The decoration is magnificent and the staff are really nice. The food was delicious and freshly made and price wasn't bad - although I wish the portions were a little larger. Over all we loved it.

google.author: Maddy Sha
google.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Oromo Lounge in Llandudno! 🌟 The bright and airy lounge boasts stunning architecture that's a feast for the eyes. The food was incredible - great taste in every dish I tried! 🍴👌 The vibe was super relaxed and welcoming, and the huge seating area was a bonus. Service was efficient too - no waiting around for anything. Big plus for the gluten-free menu options! 🙌 Will definitely be back for more. 👍 5 stars

google.author: Emily
google.text:
My husband and I had a 6.30 booking on a weekday. We arrived and it was very quiet. The manager was extremely attentive. We ordered 4 of the sharing plates - mussels, white fish, salmon and arancini.  All were delicious. The mussels were the largest I've ever seen, and we order them a lot so we do know our mussels. The atmosphere soon picked up as it got busier. We had desserts - a cherry tart and cheesecake. Both were nice but nothing to write home about - unlike the main meal which was exceptional.

I'd fully recommend it as it was the best seafood meal we had had in a long time. We watched food arrive for other tables too and it all looked fabulous.

google.author: Matt Westray
google.text:
Stayed here for a few days and it was excellent. The room was tastefully decorated ang had more than enough facilities. The shower cubicle was a bit tight but the spa bath made up for it.
Quality of food at breakfast was superb and plentiful. Evening Tapas type meal was really something else. Seafood platter plus meat platter was the best. I would not hesitate to return or recommend.

google.author: Gareth Prytherch
google.text: Stayed here for one night for my wife’s birthday. Can honestly say this is a gem of a place. We were told to phone just before arrival so we could be shown where to park. The hotel has 4 parking spots along side the building and the staff use these during the day then move for you to park. We stayed in room one which was well furnished, warm and comfortable. We ate in the restaurant at night and chose the sharing sea food platter which was amazing. Great atmosphere and excellent service. The breakfast was superb which you order on arrival. Again all food  was cooked well and the quality was excellent. Couldn’t fault anything during our stay, we were made to feel welcome and nothing was too much trouble. We will definitely return

google.author: xHJx
google.text: Visited Friday night and shared nachos for starters and then we all had pizza x great food and service

google.author: A B
google.text: First time staying here. Really nice hotel and hospitality by Brian was great.  Looked after us throughout the stay. Lovely breakfast with lots of choice on the menu. Room clean and nice size. Fridge in the  room with complimentary drinks which was a nice touch. Would definitely stay here again.

google.author: Alison Melling
google.text:
Would give this place 6 stars if I could

Visited today, the week before Christmas, with a friend. We shared a Camembert starter then had a traditional turkey dinner with extra seasonal veg. Everything was perfectly prepared, piping hot and delicious. I couldn’t believe how much food we got for the very reasonable price. Sadly too full for dessert

google.author: Caitlin Armstrong
google.text: What a fantastic find. I had the seabass for lunch and it's one of the best meals I've had in months. Very reasonably priced too. The wait staff were incredibly friendly and chatty. The decor is super cute which creates an inviting environment. I would definitely go back. It's a short walk to the promenade which leads to the pier. Perfect!

Me, my partner and our  little girl just been for a lovely Sunday lunch here we both had lamb it was lovely 😊 and lovely friendly staff 😊. We are  looking forward to coming again.

name: The Cottage Loaf

google.author: Kate Gordon
google.text:
We had a great experience here and would definitely come back! I ordered the lamb shoulder, which was absolutely exquisite. The vegetables were cooked to perfection, and the gravy was rich and delicious, though I would’ve loved a bit more of it (can never have too much gravy!). The only thing I wasn’t keen on was the red cabbage, it was a bit too sweet and overpowering for my taste. Otherwise, the dish was perfect.

My partner had the steak and ale pie, which was packed with meat and full of flavour. The pie crust could’ve used a little more seasoning, and I wasn't too keen on the texture but overall it was a hearty and satisfying dish.

The outdoor seating area is lovely, especially for dog owners, dogs are welcome outside and they even have water bowls available, which is a great touch. Just a note: dogs aren’t allowed inside.

The staff were friendly, though not especially attentive. It would have been nice to have someone check in on us during the meal. Also, table service rather than ordering at the bar would make the experience feel a bit more welcoming.

Despite a few small things, we had an amazing time. Great food, a relaxed atmosphere, and we’re already looking forward to coming back!

google.author: Mel Thompson
google.text: What a cracking pub. Great atmosphere, welcoming team who worked efficiently it was busy and had a wonderful vibe. Although we had a light lunch it arrived quickly and was really tasty. Well worth a visit

google.author: Gareth Wynne
google.text: Currently sat in this pub and the interior is stunning - low beams, real log fire, proper cottage feel. Nice pint of Inch’s at £5.50 and friendly staff. I’m not eating in here but the food they are bringing out looks amazing! Nice friendly atmosphere.

google.author: keith ball
google.text: Stopped off for food, highly recommend You book in advance, on a random wet Thursday beginning of February the place is full , sitting on a highish bench with a stool, food was excellent and the staff are very good, big smiles and nothing is too much trouble, I'd definitely eat here again, but I will book in advance , just a thought if You've got any difficulties

google.author: Pammie Roberts
google.text:
Disappointed beyond belief by the way I have been treated by this establishment, I purchased a Groupon voucher as a gift for a friend then booked a date through Groupon so I could take her for afternoon tea. Turned up at the cafe on Friday 27th just before 12PM only to find that the place was closed & in complete darkness. My friend messaged the lady to ask where they were only to be told....we have no bookings today!! Try to imagine how I felt after bringing my friend out for a treat only to find we weren't getting it. Apparently they were closed due to illness which I can empathise with but how about letting me know!! Got a snotty attitude so I contacted Groupon who told me that the cafe had cancelled our booking not Groupon as she had tried to say.
Absolutely disgusting customer treatment so as for rescheduling my booking.... JOG ON.
I have never felt so embarrassed at letting my friend down all because the cafe didn't care about our booking & no I would most definitely not recommend eating here

We will definitely go again when we go back next year. And I would highly recommend a visit

Very cosy themed tea room with quick service.

Highly recommend the afternoon tea, very polite and helpful staff!

The picture includes coffee cake, one cherry and sultana scone, one plain scone, tuna and cucumber sandwiches as well as cheddar and tomato sandwiches.

google.author: Ann Marshall
google.text:
Fantastic in every way. If you love dogs.
All in one shop. Cafe for humans. Plus Dog treats and food of many varieties.
Dog leads, harnesses etc. Plus of course Toys for your friend.
Grooming Parlour onsite means you can sit with a drink and read a book whilst all the work is being done, or drop off and go shopping.
High quality coats and beds to keep him or her warm and comfortable.

google.author: Louise Bland
google.text: Our Labrador loved visiting here, especially the scrambled eggs!. Staff helpful and friendly  breakfast sandwiches are lovely too and nice coffee we came every day of our break. We'll be back on our next break too. Thank you

google.author: Tony Willis
google.text: A great place to have a coffee with your dog or if you’re waiting whilst your dog is being groomed. Staff are welcoming and so friendly. Zak is an amazing groomer and takes time to get to know your dog. Can’t recommend this place enough and more importantly my dog would definitely recommend too 🐾 😊

google.author: MF
google.text:
Lovely to find a dog friendly cafe that even has a menu for dogs. Coffee, toasted sandwich and bagel were very nice. Clean and tidy. Just north of the main shops so able to get a table easy enough. The lady who served us was quite abrupt but the food made up for it, so still gave 5 stars. Plus our dogs loved the doggie sofa & dog treats.
Thank you for being so dog friendly 👏

google.author: Olivia Wan
google.text: lovely cozy cafe store!! love the coffee and bakery. I got the pistachio latte and I forgot the name of bakery, but both were really nice. Specially the pistachio latte, nothing like some in the market with only syrup artificial flavour, I like this one with the nut after taste.

google.author: at ashmore
google.text: Amazing fresh tasty food. Good price, good atmosphere,  great for veggies and meat eaters. Lovely place

google.author: Marc Farmer
google.text: A really nice place to stop off while in Llandudno for a bite to eat. A great selection of vegetarian meals to choose from on the menu but also lots of different delicious cakes to have. The venue is clean, tables all sanitised after every visit and there are clear screens between all the tables indoors. The staff are friendly and Emma our waitress, as well as having a beautiful smile was very helpful, efficient and got our order to us without any issues. Would definitely visit again if in the area.

google.author: Emily
google.text:
A lovely little cafe that you could easily miss by accident. Its nice and open on the inside, with a clean and fresh feel. The food is great and came quickly, and was reasonably priced. The menu said no additions or substitutions could be made which we found slightly odd, but when we asked they said we could absolutely do that.

The service was a slight let down. Staff were quick to great us and take an order but little things marred it, like leaving a tray on our table after dropping off our drinks, failing to remove empty glasses and cups when food arrived, etc

google.author: Becky Fitton
google.text: Food lovely, staff friendly. It was a nice place. Their cakes looked lovely  but I couldn't manage one. 😍

google.author: dmlawt
google.text: I’m not usually a fan of tea & cakes. I ordered a coffee whilst waiting for my car to be put through its MOT in nearby Kwikfit. What a pleasant treat to find bookshelves of poetry, cookbooks and novels to borrow. The staff are adorable. I loved the open kitchen, the menu, the inside/ outside seating, the daily joke and that they have alternative milk and delicious decaf coffee.

google.author: Anthony Grisdale
google.text: Great find, had an omelette and added to it. Tea served in a proper teapot. Friendly staff and welcoming atmosphere. Definitely recommend and will be back. Thank you.

google.author: Zoe Stokes
google.text: Very tasty full English breakfast. Good quality produce.

google.author: Dr Ipsita Konar
google.text: Cozy cute cafe with great food ! I liked their options for brunch which was a bit of variation than places around. Cozy ambience and a really sweet lady with a genuine smile helped with our orders. Stop by if you are in the area and you won’t be disappointed.

google.author: Lee Alegata
google.text: Best cafe in Llandudno in my opinion. Lovely staff, lovely breakfast.

google.author: Simon Hamilton
google.text: Amazing delicious home made food. Very nice atmosphere. Lovely staff, friendly owner and a great feel overall. Perfect for a family - can't recommend enough.

google.author: Vinit
google.text: Super cute café! The omelette was absolutely delicious and the coffee was excellent. Run by Sam and Kerry, the service was warm and attentive, and the quality of the food was outstanding. I really enjoyed my visit and would happily come back.

google.author: M
google.text: Food was excellent, we opted for the homemade steak pie and Welsh Rarebit. Delicious food and great customer service

google.author: Ian Jones
google.text:
If you’re wandering through Llandudno and your stomach starts whispering sweet nothings about bacon and eggs, do yourself a favour: head straight to Take A Break Cafe. Tucked just off the pier with a welcoming charm that’s hard to ignore, this cosy gem doesn't just serve breakfast—they deliver morning happiness, plated and perfectly brewed.

I stopped in once, fully expecting a decent fry-up. What I got was nothing short of glorious: piping hot plates stacked with all the breakfast essentials, cooked to perfection and seasoned with care. Sausages with snap, golden yolks resting on toast like royalty, and hash browns that should come with a warning label for addictive crunchiness. And the coffee? It’s the kind that convinces you that everything’s going to be alright.

So good, in fact, that I came back the next day. Yep—lightning struck twice. The staff remembered me, greeted me like an old mate, and served up another knockout breakfast that proved the first visit was no fluke.

Final thought: Take A Break Cafe lives up to its name—twice over. Great food, lovely staff, and the kind of no-nonsense quality that makes you wish breakfast lasted all day.

google.author: Pippa Roberts
google.text: Came here 11 years ago with my family and had unforgettable fish and chips. Visited again recently and the cozy vibe and quality food are still just as great! Slightly sad to see fish and chips off the menu, but everything else was delicious!!

google.author: Anthony Allen
google.text: Nice place, 4 of us went for breakfast. The service was friendly and quick. Food was nice and well presented. We all ate everything and would happily return. It seems to open earlier than some of the other cafes nearby as well, which we found useful.

name: Tiffany Cafe Bar

google.author: adam holden
google.text:
Lovely welcome with toys and books for our boy and a puppycino for our wee dog. The service was second to none and staff were lovely. The food was great and good sized portions for a good price. The decor and music are nice too, giving a Parisian art Deco feel.

The chicken burger we had was stacked and well cooked and the hunters gammon was well cooked.

We'll definitely come back next time we're in the area.

google.author: bren
google.text:
Splendid atmosphere. Service wonderful.
Matt Munro and Perry Como playing throughout.
Fine teas and wine enjoyed
Surprised to discover cellar bar area which hosts interesting events. See photos.
Gents toilets offer medical advice at urinals.
Never seen that before

google.author: Kevin Booker
google.text: Were not meant to be going here but so glad we did. Made to feel more than welcome, especially Marilyn our pooch. She was given treats and a puppachino before all our party even got there. As for the food, it was really good, so tasty and reasonably priced. Service was great and so friendly.  Will definitely go again if back in Llandudno.

google.author: Debra Ball
google.text: We called in yesterday with our dog, it’s was cold and wet out, we had amazing cake, coffee and hot chocolate, our dog got a blanket to lie on and a doggie cream biscuit dessert and water. We felt very spoiled. Staff were really lovely. We had such a lovely experience we are back for the same today, highly recommend.

google.author: Ali Donohue
google.text:
Great place, lovely food and the staff were so lovely.
I've been here before and would definitely recommend people walk to this cafe for some food and drink.
Also dog friendly, they brought a cushion and a puppicino for my dog.

description: High-end American retailer known for fine jewelry, china & silver, plus wedding registry.

google.author: Jason Wilson
google.text:
We’re locals from Conwy, and had guests from London staying with us. What could be better than a cafe trip for lunch for some simple food in Llandudno to finish the day out.  Well, no. The cafe was warm and inviting. Getting one of the deals advertised proved a challenge and there was a long wait. No worries there if the food was good, but sadly it wasn’t. The chicken burger bun was burned and scraped, with a miserable dry patty. The jacket potato was small, dry and grim. The few beans and smattering of flavourless cheese scattered on the sad butterless potato didn’t inspire confidence. The fish and chips were tolerable, but not good, had some bones.

The biggest disappointment was the ‘grilled fish of the day with salad’.  Which turned up completely raw, un-seasoned, and looked like it was just placed under a warming plate rather than the advertised grill. It was pangasius fish (from Vietnam) in a coastal Welsh town, in a place advertising fish of the day, which we had asked in advance. This we wouldn’t have minded that too much if it was actually cooked! It even turned up with chips rather than salad, which they did correct, and they refunded the fish when this was raised.

It’s a cafe, we wouldn’t expect Masterchef, but there are many many great cafe’s in Llandudno serving tasty food and we’ve eaten in lots of them. Most of my reviews are positive ones, and we are not the type
to complain. This was also expensive.

While we love supporting local businesses instead of eating in something like Wetherspoons, an experience like this sadly deserves to be called out, and standards like this should not be tolerated. Cafe’s shouldn’t have things on the menu they have no idea how to cook.

Avoid at all costs, it’ll ruin your day.

google.author: 99th Pennine
google.text: I wish I had read the reviews before stepping into this place!!! It was our first time in Llandudno and after a 3 hour journey my daughter was hungry. We first went into Cafe Nero and due to the queue walked across to cafe culture. We purchased 2 meals, a jacket potato with tuna and cheese with “home coleslaw” haha!!! and fish and chips with 2 drinks and paid £52 OMG!!! The food was disgusting! The cucumbers in the salad were off and I asked for another salad and she took it away and bought back the same salad without the cucumber. The coleslaw looked like it had been soaked in water! The glass smelt musty and the chips had been fried in old oil. Put a complete dampener on our day!!!! Avoid this place at all costs!!! Such a shame as there was so many places to eat. The cafe was big and completely empty which should have been a huge giveaway but we rushed and being too polite didn’t bother complaining! This place should be shut!!

google.author: Lacey Remz
google.text: I did not even want to rate this cafe 1 star I rate it 0 star! Where do I even start. Came to Llandudno for a day trip and was looking for some where decent to eat . We was originally going to the Wetherspoons but we changed our minds as we wanted some thing new and different. We wish we just stuck to the Wetherspoons and that’s saying something! This place is OUTRAGEOUSLY SHOCKING AND THE PRICES  ARE EXTORTIONATE for poor quality food. The cake we ordered was hard and steal the panini was literally just a HARD baguette with the tiniest bit of cheese with just loads of onion. The chips was hard and crispy and tasted like they had been cooked in old oil. The hot chocolate I ordered tasted strong and I could still see the chocolate powder in my drink. I ordered a garlic pizza AND IT WAS DISGUSTING OVER COOKED and burnt at the ends my child  refused to eat it when approaching the manger to talk about our concerns she had a attitude looked at the garlic bread and said that’s how we cook it and refused us a refund. I have been to Italian restaurants and that’s definitely not how they serve there garlic bread! I can not believe we paid £45 for poor quality food tiny tiny amount of cheese on the panini that which came out as baguette. You get better food at a back street shop! google.text:
Avoid avoid avoid
It says freshly home cooked food it came out and looked like 3 months old hard black roast chicken and chips looked like it been cooked. google.text:
Avoid at all costs!!!
Absolute disgusting food!
Absolutely terrible experience!
nearly £15 for the smallest piece of fish ever, how it didn't get thrown back at the catch I'll never know. No peas as an accompaniment nothing just a tiny fish and couple of chips. Disgraceful. Only good thing about this place there are two exits. Do yourselves a favour avoid at all costs

google.author: Ry Forshaw
google.text:
I stopped by while scouting for a filming location and couldn’t have been made more welcome. Forte's were incredibly hospitable from the moment we walked in, hapilly allowing us to film a short video.
The coffee was spot on and the ice cream was just as good as you’d hope. A lovely atmosphere, friendly service, a real gem in Llandudno. I'll definitely be back.

google.author: Trevor Hardman
google.text: Having spent a week in Llandudno, this became our daily go to coffee shop, the coffee and hot chocolate is amazing the best we have ever tasted. Along with great staff, so helpful and polite. Not just in this shop but also in the restaurant in Llandudno and Rhoss on sea. Thank you for making it such a lovely week and we will be back.

google.author: Sanmat Jhanjhari
google.text:
If you're looking for the best ice cream in Llandudno, look no further! During my visit, I had the pleasure of being served by a lovely lady who was incredibly generous and courteous. She allowed us to sample several flavors, which made it so much easier to choose our favorites. I highly recommend trying the Coffee ice cream; it is absolutely one of the best flavors I’ve ever tasted!

The staff at this ice cream shop truly creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere. They make you feel right at home from the moment you walk in, and their enthusiasm for their product is evident. If you're in Llandudno, this place is a must-visit for any ice cream lover!

google.author: A B
google.text: There are two Fortes outlets in Llandudno, the one in the town centre is a cafe/restaurant and this one, which is close to Bog Island, which is an ice cream parlour/coffee shop.  I've yet to try the ice cream but the coffee is very good.  Downsides are that it's quite small so there's no guarantee of finding a free table and also for some reason they don't open until 10:30am so sometimes we've been in and out of town before they've opened so we have to go elsewhere for coffee.

google.author: M U
google.text: Waffles or crepes, ice cream or coffee what ever you fancy for you can pop in and order and just enjoy your food or drink. Tried both waffles and crepes, just awesome. Price seems ok. Staffs are nice, food served quick, atmosphere was lovely. Toilet facilities available. Highly recommended.

google.author: Angie Li
google.text: Had a wonderful dinner with friends. The seating may be limited, but the cozy vibe really enhances the experience. The fusion dishes are delightful! If you have any special requests, feel free to let the chef know, they're happy to accommodate

google.author: Jacqui Higgins
google.text: We found this lovely café after walking our large dog on Conwy Beach. As usual, I asked if it was okay for him to come in and he was warmly welcomed. The breakfast menu is excellent. For under £9 we could choose seven items from a comprehensive list that included hash browns, bacon, sausage, vegetarian sausage, mushrooms, baked beans, toast, etc.  The teas and coffee were wonderful, hot and my coffee was very smooth. The portions were very generous and everything was cooked well. This is obviously a local social hub with groups coming in to have coffee and cake and read their papers on the easy chairs in the window. There was no rush and the staff were efficient and chatty without being intrusive. Next time we are in the area we will be visiting again.

google.author: Liwis Poon
google.text: Lamb shank was better than I expected because I was worried about the gaminess of lamb. It was my friend who ordered it, and I tried a bite. Surprisingly, it wasn't gamey and was very juicy. I was pleasantly surprised to find Japanese curry here. It's not spicy (you can request extra spice but me not) and it absolutely brought back memories of my trip to Japan years ago.

google.author: Shafaq Kazmi
google.text: Tried their cheese on toast with a homemade cake slice. Everything was good 🫰

google.author: John Humphreys
google.text: Random pop in today for lunch with my dad, lovely and cosy, had soup with a toasted sandwich both delicious and 2 hot cups of coffee. Service was great and owner was very pleasant, will definitely be visiting again. Highly recommend👍👍

name: Candles

google.author: Debbie Oliver
google.text: First visit, had restaurant to ourselves which was lovely. Had one starter pate, sea bass, salmon provençale and two lemon cheesecakes, all delicious.

google.author: Angharad Thomas
google.text:
I booked Candles for my work's End of Year Dinner and it was the best meal I've had in ages.  There were 16 of us in total, and that high number didn't bother them at all.  All of our food came together and it was unbelievably delicious.  My Chicken a la Creme was incredible, and the best Calamari (starter) that I've ever had.

I'm not from the area, and I'm just so glad that we booked here.  All the staff were so friendly, and they made it so easy to book.  Everyone absolutely loved it, and the wine was great!  Would highly recommend!

I would like to take this opportunity to thank Candles for accommodating us and giving us an amazing End of Year Dinner after a super busy year.  Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!

google.author: Michael A Jones
google.text: Lovely little restaurant, very friendly staff. We will definitely be going back.

google.author: tako xo
google.text:
Overall a good restaurant. Starter I ordered the mayo prawns- not what I was expecting (thought the prawns would be a bit larger in size) but it is quite an interesting dish. Recommended for mayo lovers.
Main course I ordered the rainbow trout and it's great! There are fish bones though so if anyone orders it in the future, do be aware of them.
Tiramisu is also decent.
Staff are lovely. Prices are alright- I'd say it's slightly expensive for what is provided if I have to be honest (around £24.00 for 3 courses). But a solid choice for dinner overall.

google.author: Hannah Morgan
google.text: I had a lovely time here with my Nain and Taid! I had the peppered chicken whereas my Nain had the salmon fillet and my Taid had something else which were all so tasty. The atmosphere was so comforting and you definitely get all of your money's worth with the portion sizes as they offer two sides!!! During my meal the staff members were so welcoming including a lovely waitress whos name was Ava, checking up on us at the perfect time.

description: Family-run restaurant with contemporary decor and candlelit tables, for British and European dishes.

google.author: Jay
google.text: Me and the partner on a proper hunger moment and it caught our eye, she had the fish cakes, I had the Welsh ogie... served super quick and we were just in before the kitchen closed so really appreciate the effort. Fast nommy and would come again

google.author: joanne scott
google.text: This was a great little cafe in Llandudno. Very dog friendly with a dog menu.and excellent customer service. Highly recommend.

google.author: Dorina Lloyd
google.text: The restraunt it self is modern and clean .we did wait about 40mins  for food. I had a panini which was nice .but my daughter had fishfinger bap .with chips  .sh e didn't like the food ..cheap frozen chips 🍟  fish fingers no taste .disappointed. u go down stairs to toilets there was a dirty. smell .all the way down to the toilets

google.author: Cynnan Jones
google.text: Very nice place. Went on a date here with my girlfriend, not that busy at all, very quiet and calming atmosphere. The food ordering process was very simple. A bit of a wait but we asked for a very specific order so it's to be expected. The food was absolutely delightful (highly recommend the burger), and the portions were pleasing. Very happy overall, will come again if I find myself in Llandudno.

google.author: Mark Hampson
google.text: Me and the misses popped in for some lunch while we were shopping in Llandudno. Got to say, the food was out of this world. The food was excellent. The staff were also excellent. Friendly, polite and helpful. Didn’t have to wait long for the food. This is now are new favourite place to come for food in Llandudno. Definitely will be back

google.author: Charlotte “Char”
google.text: We adored this cute little Italian restaurant. We nearly walked past it on the street, but glad we paid a visit. It's got a lovely vibe, homely and warm, and the staff were very friendly. To start, we had a garlic pizza to share, with the most prefect crust. We both had the special pasta to follow, which was a tagliatelle with a saucy, slightly spicy, meaty sauce - it was melt in the mouth!

google.author: Jessica Plu
google.text: The best italian we have ever been to, pasta cooked to perfection everything had so much flavour. Can't wait to come back

google.author: Bethan W
google.text:
Amazing little Italian restaurant nestled in the heart of Llandudno! Gorgeous food, hand made authentic Italian bases with unique and delicious toppings. The staff were so knowledgeable about the menu and attentive throughout our visit.
They even made me a mocha which wasn't on the menu, thank you so much, it was delicious!

100% recommend for all occasions!

google.author: Nur A Jannat
google.text: The food and service were absolutely amazing.  I can’t even begin to describe how comfortable I felt.  I’ve never experienced anything like it anywhere else. Our lovely young server made my evening and the meal truly unforgettable.

google.author: R P
google.text: I highly recommend the restaurant, it  has delicious food. Fantastic and cozy atmosphere. We will definitely come back sooner or later! Thank you for a fantastic evening. Great family business, it is cooked with passion and love. We enjoyed the very good taste of the food.

google.author: Hira Khalil
google.text:
This was hands down the most incredible pizza I’ve ever had anywhere in the world. From the very first bite, everything was perfectly balanced—the crust was light and crispy on the outside, soft and airy inside, with just the right hint of char. The sauce tasted fresh and vibrant, and the cheese was rich, creamy, and melted to absolute perfection.

Every ingredient felt thoughtfully chosen and high quality, coming together in a way that elevated a simple pizza into something unforgettable. It wasn’t just food—it was an experience that set a new benchmark for what great pizza should be.

What truly made the experience even better was the generous service. They served complimentary extra fries and drinks, which was a lovely and unexpected touch that showed how much they value their customers.

On top of that, the lady behind the counter was absolutely wonderful—polite, friendly, and very professional in the way she handled everything. Her warm attitude made the visit even more enjoyable.

Amazing food, great hospitality, and thoughtful service. If you consider yourself a pizza lover, this is a must-try. One bite is enough to understand why this pizza stands above the rest.

google.author: Muhammad Junaid Zafar
google.text:
The best burger spot in Llandudno!
DINOS serves incredibly flavourful Turkish-style grill burgers, which are halal, a big plus. I really like that they offer lots of customisation options, so you can build your burger exactly how you want it.
I tried the Anaconda burger, which comes with grilled red chillies and some amazing sauces. The flavours were smoky, rich, and perfectly balanced — definitely one of the tastiest burgers I’ve had.
The owner is also an amazing person, very kind and welcoming, which made the experience even better.
10/10 — highly recommended if you're in Llandudno and want a proper grilled burger.

google.author: Ali K.
google.text:
Having visited countless burger places across the West, I can confidently say that Dino’s Llandudno exceeded all expectations. It is easily one of the best spots we've found for a genuine North American taste.
The burgers were incredible and my kids absolutely enjoyed every bite. What really stood out, though, was the service. The staff was very friendly with us and the kids, showing a genuine passion for their work that you just don't see everywhere.
If you want a top-quality burger and a welcoming atmosphere, this is the place to go. We will definitely be back!

google.author: Michael CADWALADR
google.text: I’ve got to say the heart attack burger was the juiciest nicest burger I’ve ever had 10/10 highly recommended this place ! The best experience was the owner so polite very nice to talk to . 3 of us was eating there I only wanted a heart attack burger on its own because I was low on funds tbh ! And the owner brought me chips with it also a 12 once garlic bread on the house which was amazing and also gave us ice cream and cookie dough on the house ! I will 100% return with my family 🤤😃

google.author: Muhammad Omer (Omer)
google.text:
We visited Dino in Llandudno with my family for a meal. After quite a bit of effort, we eventually managed to find parking nearby.

The food was decent but nothing memorable. Portion sizes were reasonable; however, the burgers didn’t taste particularly fresh. For what was served, the pricing felt high, £38 for one burger meal with chips and a drink, one wings portion, a kids’ meal, and a garlic bread starter doesn’t feel like good value.

The server was great, friendly and attentive - which was a highlight of the visit. The restaurant atmosphere was okay, though it was fairly quiet at the time.

On a positive note, it’s always appreciated to find halal food options in a small town like Llandudno. Overall, I’d rate the food 6/10

name: East
description: Charming, major thoroughfare offering diverse shops & restaurants, plus religious landmarks.

google.author: Deb Harrison (Deb321pink)
google.text:
First time coming to this restaurant & we absolutely loved the food and experience.
As soon as we walked in we were greeted with lovely friendly staff.
The buffet food & main meal was fresh & delicious & a lovely selection of cakes & fruit for afters.
We can’t wait to go back next time we are in Llandudno

google.author: Tony Bates (babblingbates)
google.text:
What an amazing restaurant. We were greeted very warmly at the door and seated at a lovely table with prawn crackers awaiting us on the table.

The buffet selection for the starters was really good, as was the crispy duck, which we helped ourselves to.

Main courses were made to order and were also brilliant.

We finished off with a lovely selection of small desserts and Whippy ice cream.

The chef/owner came out for a chat and what a lovely man.

Highly recommended!

google.author: Jason
google.text:
I was very disappointed with my recent visit, as it was nothing like I remember. The variety of starters was limited and uninspiring, and what we tried was overcooked and unpleasant. The mains were equally underwhelming, with sauces that were far too thick and heavy. Even the soup was so thick it felt like I was chewing it.

Unfortunately, we didn’t even finish our food or the wine. The bottle of wine was served warm and wasn’t placed in a cooler, which was also disappointing. On top of that, the restaurant was uncomfortably warm, which made me feel unwell, and the noise level was so high that it was difficult to have a conversation. Overall, a very disappointing experience.

All that being said, the staff were very friendly and accommodating.

google.author: BIG Kev G
google.text: Fantastic food, amazing friendly staff. I would highly recommend you try this place, well worth the visit. The place is super clean, freshly cooked starters which is all you can eat. Main meal you order off the menu but again all you can eat so you can order more if you like. And amazing deserts again all you can eat and excellent quality. You will NOT be disappointed *****

google.author: Rakesh Khambhaita
google.text: Seems like they have a good choice. However food didn’t taste fresh even rice and noodles were not fresh. in the buffet. Good selection of desserts. Staff were warm and welcoming.

name: Forte's Restaurant

google.author: BARBARA SMOK
google.text:
I visited Fortes Restaurant in Llandudno once again. New Year 2026 was one of their busiest times, but the very welcoming and attentive manager, Paul, approached us quickly and showed us to our table. Despite how busy it was, everything appeared to be very well organised.
This time we only stopped in for coffee, but I took the opportunity to also order scrambled eggs on gluten-free toast. The coffee is always excellent, and the latte art on the surface adds real visual pleasure and clearly shows a high level of professionalism. Michal was working on the drinks section, and whenever he makes coffee, it is always of a very high standard.
We paid £17.15 for two coffees and a generous portion of scrambled eggs with toast. The prices are not the lowest, but I have visited places in Llandudno and Conwy offering a similar standard of food and service at similar prices.
People are happy to return because of the consistently high level of customer service and strong management presence. People buy from people, and that truly makes a difference.
Thank you to everyone.

google.author: Azize Dogu
google.text: We’ve visited Llandudno in the end of February and stayed in our hotel which had its own cafe. But after a few more standard english breakfasts we were wondering if there’s something more unusual we could eat in the mornings, and that’s how we found out about the Forte’s! The place is clean, interior is beautiful, staff is kind, and the food no matter what dish we ordered was fantastic! Thank you! Our family would especially recommend the crepes!

google.author: Stephanie Foster
google.text:
We came to Fortes in Llandudno as we fancied an ice cream after a day out and it was fantastic!

Inside looked lovely but we chose to eat outside which they said they didn’t usually do with the glass ice cream bowls but said okay as it was a nice day, we did take everything back in after we were done and they said thanks! They were all so polite!

The drinks and ice cream were fantastic!

I had the mocha or cappuccino (something coffee based) ice cream which was one of the nicest I’d ever had, mom had banana and my dad had chocolate and all were lovely!

Would definitely come again! The ice cream is well worth it and the staff are so nice!

google.author: Louise C
google.text:
First visit and the last!!!
My boyfriend and I visited this afternoon the staff were lovely and friendly.
My boyfriend ordered the chilli It was well presented and he was happy. I ordered the veggie breakfast. Sadly the scrambled egg had been made with a LOT of single cream it was white and very runny the plate was swimming in cream. Gutted I didn't take a picture I have never seen or tasted anything like.. it's not how I know scrambled egg it's yellow where I come from not white and runny.
There was that much cream on my plate it went onto my hash brown and made it soggy. It had no taste it was Horrible!! I called over a member of staff who I think was management he said it would change it and bring me a fresh breakfast. I would've been happy with just the scrambled egg being redone and putting onto a clean plate I told him why I was unhappy and he took it away I waited 20 minutes before it returned.
My boyfriend had finshed his lunch..
The scrambled egg had been redone In a ramekin in a microwave not nice..
I tipped it out and. look more like a white Soufflé and tasted horrible again overpowered with single cream which poured all over my plate why can a chef make scrambled eggs ?? I eat the beans and  mushrooms and a slice of toast as all the cream on the plate that making me feel sick.. I asked for the bill and told the gentleman again I wasn't happy as it was just the same as the first time and he knocked the pot off tea off my bill not what I expected after all the hassle And it's still not being right the second time and unable to eat it..
I definitely shouldn't have been charged for the breakfast.
He even tried to convince me that's how scrambled eggs are made..
I had a cafe for 15 years I can assure you that wasn't scrambled egg.. so avoid the scrambled eggs folks !!! Gutted I didn't take pictures

google.author: Rosa Mak-Frost
google.text:
My husband and I with our Shiba went to Forte's for dinner tonight. I was glad to know that dogs are allowed inside the eatery. On the previous night, we struggled to find somewhere to eat where my Shiba was allowed inside. We did end up dining al fresco.

I believe that the waitress serving us is called Sharon. She was so caring for my dog as it have been a hot day. She bought him a bowl of water and was fussing over him.

My husband likes his hamburger
and I thoroughly enjoyed the pork steak with apple cream and cider sauce. Good portion served

We were pleased to find Forte's

description: Numerous classic & exotic ice cream flavours offered with burgers, pizza, coffee, tea & more.

name: Harvey's New York Bar & Grill

google.author: Emma Smith-Bodie
google.text:
Good music, great decor on theme. Our server was really friendly and attentive, on her own but not a lot of people in there.
Food was decent, nothing spectacular but good decent grub.
The menu is very good for meat lovers. I had the veggie burger and it was decent (came with an extra patty?!)

google.author: Lord Kenneth Montgomery-Moore
google.text: This establishment has a very welcoming atmosphere with a heavy splash of American Genre with classic R&R music.. Now the food, and service.. Outstanding from the start to finish.. Even having the fine opportunity in meeting the chef who created our meals from the top level of professionalism and skills, clearly takes pride in his craft... Our experience here I firmly give "Excellent" marks...

google.author: Living The Dream
google.text: I visited here Friday (12.09.25) evening, with my parents one of whom is disabled. All the staff were polite and friendly! The food was very nice. We only gave it a chance it is certainly not a place my parents would normally choose! But we all enjoyed the food, the friendliness of the staff and the music which with its volume and type created a great atmosphere.

google.author: Matt Thomas
google.text: Staff were sound but the food was awful. I don't think I've never given a bad review on google but had to for those fajitas, I don’t know how you can make chicken, steak, peppers and onions taste bad. There was no spice added at all which is just bizarre but it wasn't even fried. Steak had no flavour, chicken seemed grilled and slightly burnt and onions and peppers tasted were odd tasting, like as if microwaved. I have no idea how they could make this food taste so bad. And it's £25! If you want to eat something three times as tasty eat a slice of bread.

google.author: Richard Slade
google.text: Great food and service, music kept skipping every now and then but doesn't ruin the atmosphere at all. We went on a weekday so it was fairly quiet

description: American memorabilia adorns this modern joint for grill classics including burgers, steaks and ribs.

name: Home Cookin'

google.author: R AY
google.text: Their curry chicken was really good. I liked their thick fries and baked potatoes, which were not salty (a big plus). The chicken Caesar salad was outstanding, and the croutons were freshly made. For the beef lasagna, the garlic bread was the highlight (since I’m a bread lover). The grilled seabass wasn’t bad either.

google.author: Jo Wood
google.text: Visited here about a month ago (December), have been a few times already, food is excellent, true home cooking, the place is lovely, nice friendly staff, service was very quick, breakfast was delicious, recommend coming here both for either breakfast or evening dinner!

google.author: Evelyn
google.text: It was a bit price for simple food, super tasty and comforting, welcomed very quickly and drinks arrived straight away. Apparently no one eats there’s under 65 years old, nothing wrong with that but just have in mind that.

google.author: Andrew Whittingham
google.text: Visited on Sunday 8th Feb solely based on the online reviews and wasn’t disappointed. I had the turkey roast and my wife had the pork steak, both were excellent. They were good portion sizes and very tasty. My wife had a dark cherry pavlova for her desert and said it was “to die for”. Very reasonably priced and totally recommended. Will definitely return next time we are in Llandudno.

google.author: Rachel Parry
google.text:
Really good food for late lunch today (30 Mar) and lovely staff! Kids meal is really generous, especially the pudding size after! Adult portion of chocolate fudge cake for dessert in the kids set menu! The kids eyes were huge when they saw it 🤣

Only had the honey ham salad which was delicious. Menu had so much choice so will definitely have to come back to try more.

description: Home-style British fare, including seafood & roasts, in a stylish, earth-toned setting with wines.

name: Johnny Dough's Wood-Fired Pizza

google.author: keith garner
google.text:
My partner is coeliac (gluten intolerant) and we have to be careful where we eat, absolutely no issues here, the staff were knowledgeable and understanding as well as being friendly and efficient.
My partner said her pizza was the best she'd had and the bonus of the base being the same size as other bases (which isn't the norm) my pizza was superb as well.
Great to see families enjoying their time together which made for a great atmosphere.

google.author: Sarah McAteer
google.text:
LOVED this place!
Pizzas were amazing, staff were lovely, very reasonably priced.
Lovely deserts although we shared as we were so full from the pizzas!

google.author: S P
google.text: Pizza was great. The “super spicy” option is Tabasco sauce though - not to everyone’s taste for the type of spice.

google.author: Bethany Dixon
google.text: The boys loved it! They were able to make their own pizzas and actually ate every bite, which is not common. Friendly staff. Clean bathrooms and lots of space when we arrived.

google.author: Jshep
google.text:
For someone with allergies I had the best service & one of the best pizzas I’ve ever had.
The owner gave me a list of what I couldn’t have considering my allergies and even cleaned the oven out before doing my pizza, some great service I have never gotten elsewhere.
That aside, the pizza tasted perfect, not too spicy, not too overwhelmingly cheesy or anything and packed with flavour.

description: Rustic, brick-clad place serving wood-fired pizza with creative toppings, cocktails, beer & wine.

address.fullAddress: 83 A, 83 Church Walks, Llandudno LL30 2HD, UK

google.author: 19dash66
google.text:
A lovely Indian restaurant, much better than the one opposite. Service was great. The restaurant and the food were lovely. I'll be going again for sure the next time I visit Llandudno
10/10 👌

google.author: Mayrine MacLennan
google.text: We had the most fantastic dinner here - best of our holiday by far. Traditional Italian cooking with excellent service. Would highly recommend a visit but book in advance.

google.author: Kevin Jones
google.text: This was a wonderful experience. Pleasant place, staff are welcoming. Food was excellent. Best to pre-book as I think they get very busy. Will definitely go back.

google.author: giannis maximos
google.text: Classic Italian  restaurant, food was quite nice. The portions very small, so If we hadn't gotten starters we would have left hungry, its spaghetti cost nonetheless fill the plates. Nice limonchelo. Melitzana starter was really nice, we order focaccia but I think this look more like pizza baze than focaccia, had focaccia many times in Italians and are much different and fluffy bread.

google.author: Matt Griffiths
google.text: Had a great birthday meal here. The menu was very good, and the food freshly cooked and very nice. The lady serving at the table was attentive and friendly, and the prices are good. Can't fault anything. Thanks for a good evening.

google.author: Shanna Ashton
google.text: Highly recommended. Food was amazing!  Despite it being a Saturday and fairly busy there was only one server but he was friendly and polite and kept service flowing well so we didn't notice any long delays.  In the busier season it would be a good idea to book in advance but we were seated right away and menus and drinks were brought promptly.  Starters took about 10-15 minutes to arrive and the mains came about 10 minutes after we finished the starters.  All the food was delicious and well made.  We had the mixed kebab and tandoori chicken starters, both with fresh salad - good balance of spices, well cooked and served hot.  My husband had the Bengal style fish curry and I had the chicken passanda with pilau rice and we shared a cheese naan.  We polished the plates clean - absolutely delicious and would definitely have these dishes again.

google.author: Kevin Davies
google.text: Visited while stopping in Llandudno for the weekend. Excellent quality food. The starters were amazing. Cooked to perfection and loads of flavour. Very nice decor and very friendly staff. Was server by Sandep who was very helpful when checking which items were Gluten Free, nothing was to much trouble. Will be back next time we visit Llandudno

google.author: Frankie Francis
google.text: Excellent quality food … The starters were amazing. Cooked to perfection and loads of flavour. Very nice decor and very friendly staff. Was served by Sandep who was very helpful when checking which items were gluten-free, nothing was too much trouble. Will be back next time we visit Llandudno.

google.author: Paul Wild
google.text: Now I've seen some bad reviews about this place, so thought I'd put on our review. We were looking for somewhere to eat, after been let down somewhere else, and come across this place. They got us in, and believe me the service was very good, The food arrived I had the chef's lamb, and I can honestly say, if was bloody lovely, and the rest of the party, all found there food very enjoyable. Actually we all said, it was probably the best Indy, we'd had in llandudno. So I find the negative reviews puzzling. We'd definitely go back again. 👍

google.author: Hannah McDonald
google.text:
Great to see vegan options on the menu, especially as this is a new restaurant, and the main dishes can be ordered as veg curries too. Though it was difficult to inquire about the use of dairy ghee when ordering the veg dishes and fried rice, but the staff were very polite and friendly about it. The veg curries were £12 which is expensive compared to other Indian restaurants in the area (normally about £10), but we did save money by bringing our own wine. No alcohol is served here and the beers and wines on the menu are alcohol free. In terms of the food itself, the Pathia was my favourite for it's sweet and sour taste, and the dhal met my usual standards. The food wasn't spicy, so if you like spice I'd request it or order a spicy dish. The major downside to the food was the big chunks of garlic cloves in it that were pretty much cut in half! It was a challenge to eat it all, and we also had garlic rice with it too, so it was way too much garlic! There was also no vegan option for breads, I'd like to see chapatis or rotis on there in the future. Also think it would be useful to have allergen numbers next to the dishes on the menu. The atmosphere was okay but a bit hot, a fan or AC would help during summer. Really appreciated the takeaway box they gave us, we could choose how we wanted to put the food in and I had a great breakfast the next day :) Portions were quite generous too.
Suggestions:
- thinner sliced garlic
- rotis or chapatis
- AC/fan during summer
- allergens listed on the menu

google.author: Peter Rourke
google.text:
A rare takeaway for us tonight, but a very good choice.

I have been so disappointed over the years with the quality of fish and chips in Llandudno,  but I decided to try again at Pebbles for the first time.

Nice. Very nice. The fish was lightly battered, crispy and there was an enormous amount!

The chips were crispy and soft. Peas and gravy were both excellent too.

Had to remove some batter and share the fish with my dog!!!

Very tasty, thank you 👍

google.author: Sean Sayers
google.text:
Stopped in for lunch whilst on holiday as a family of 6.

Really fast and friendly service.

Great selection of food, and the staff were also very accommodating.

We ordered cod and chips, cod special, chicken burger and chips, sausage and chips, 2 deserts and drinks. In total we paid £80 which is a good price.

The fish was cooked perfectly - no bones and wasn't oily at all.

google.author: tasha jarvis
google.text:
December 2024
Really enjoyed our fish and chips here. The mushy peas are the best I've ever tasted. Prices are very reasonable for a sit down meal with high quality food. They have a very good offering of desserts but we were too full to try them. I will definitely go back here if I'm visiting Llandudno

December 2025
Came back as I really enjoyed it last time.  Mushy peas are still delicious. The fish was huge this time. Also, I managed to squeeze in dessert (I've been thinking about their lemon meringue pie for a whole year 😅) delicious 😋

google.author: Google Curator
google.text: Very friendly and help, to grab a mid afternoon fish and chips for my son. A small portion of fish and chips for £7.95, freshly cooked. My son enjoyed it but the chips could have been a bit more crispy. Would visit again though.

google.author: ToffeeWorld at Toffee Heaven Ltd (Toffeeworld)
google.text: Nice traditional fish and chips, we had a mini cod and chips and a standard haddock and chips with mushy peas and traditional fruity curry sauce which really made the meal, best curry sauce I've had in north wales fruity with a slight spicy kick, also very good mushy peas, fish and chips nicely cooked. Well worth a visit.

name: Romeo Ristorante Italiano

google.author: Leslie Weston
google.text:
Sept 2024. This fabulous Italian restaurant in Llandudno was recommended on the hotel website and was perfect.
It is upstairs above a Greek restaurant so the door can be missed, but once upstairs you know you are in an Italian restaurant. The welcome from the staff was great and the seating comfortable and spacious.
Portions were very generous and delicious. There was a lot of choice and plenty to satisfy everyone, including a good choice of wines. Service was excellent and we did not have to wait too long between courses, but we’re not felt rushed.
We enjoyed it so much we went back two days later!

google.author: chris Tanner
google.text:
An amazing little gem of a place!

Recommended if you fancy pizza or pasta … so many places to choose here and we picked THE ONE to go!

No booking, friendly service …

Initial thoughts slightly more expensive than others … but!!! Worth every penny paid!

Went for a pizza and 2 starters … had prawn pasta main as a half dish … 10 king prawns £8.90…

Food very good quality great flavours …

Staff happy to chat adding to the good vibes … Sunday night very busy …

If visiting make this your #1 place to try for Italian …

Thank you!!!

google.author: Sam Hubball
google.text:
The food selection and genuine Italian theming and selection are great! The portions were large, even the child's spaghetti bolognaise (at £8.50) would have been more than enough for most people. Great selection of food and drinks. Lovely venue upstairs with the sun shining thru the windows
Would recommend 100%

google.author: Sam Fang
google.text:
the sea beam on the special menu and the mussel pasta are great! we like it!

the pizza is just soso, can't compare to what we eat in Italy and some other places of UK. you may skip this.

we ordered a lemonade and a moretti beer, the bill is around 70 pounds overall.

overall quite good, will come again when we visit this place.

google.author: Amy
google.text: Lovely clean restaurant, with great helpful staff, and even more lovely food to top it all of. Would highly recommend this restaurant and would certainly return if was ever in the area again.

description: Authentic yet innovative Mediterranean cuisine on a weekly-changing menu, with an emphasis on fish.

address.fullAddress: Glan Y Mor Parade, Llandudno LL30 2LL, UK

google.author: Ladies That Lunch in Style
google.text:
Llandudno Esplanade Hotel on the prom opposite Llandudno Pier.
Huge refurb on the hotel. How did we not know about this fabulous restaurant. Absolutely 10/10👜 handbag restaurant review. Compliments to the chef Jason Hughes featured on Great British Menu. WOW to the menu and all the delicious flavours. We tried the festive lunch menu (only £2 extra for the three course so why not 🥳) Festive dinner menu looked good too 👏. Love the presentation. Love the atmosphere. Love the decor in here. Everywhere is immaculate even the kitchen 5 hygiene rating 👏. Uniformed well trained staff. Front of house Gareth what a welcome and very informative. We also heard how you greeted others and treated everyone the same. Wish all maitre d hosted as good as you. Highly recommend you try here. We parked in the shopping centre multi story car park. Some parking available on the prom.

google.author: Phillip Wicks
google.text:
Goat is one of my favourite restaurants. The venues is beautifully designed and decorated. The staff were all warm and welcoming, the food is absolutely delicious.
I had a Welsh onion Soup followed soup, Beef shin with goose fat roasted potatoes and then a Burnt Welsh cream pudding. All the meals were so tasty and wonderfully presented. I would highly recommend this venue.

google.author: Rebecca Banks
google.text: Fantastic time at The Goat - HIGHLY RECOMMEND! When you step into The Goat you feel like you are in a swanky restaurant in a city, I can not believe I have not visited this place before, it is just stunning! The food was so delicious, some of the best food we have had in a long time. The service was great and the staff were really friendly. The decor is just stunning with impeccable attention to detail. I can not wait to visit The Goat again.

google.author: Valerie Dell
google.text: Gorgeous venue. Fabulous food, compliments to the chefs. Amazing French onion soup follows by Turkey for me, my husband had the beef & just wow 🤩 A taste sensation. Fabulous Aperol spritz as well. Attentive yet discreet service. Highly recommend

google.author: Dan
google.text:
Popped hear with friends and my god son for a breakfast with santa. A really good experience and the breakfast was amazing. The staff are lovely and chatty. We got to meet santa after our food, which was a great touch for the little one.
Highly recommended taking you little ones to see santa and get a breakfast to.

address.fullAddress: Next Door Hotel, 20 Gloddaeth St, Llandudno LL30 2DP, UK

google.author: Beth Murray
google.text: The best meal we have ever had! I never usually leave reviews but after the dinner we had yesterday it would feel wrong not to. Every plate we had was a 10/10 both dinner and dessert. Our server Bethan was wonderful, the ambiance of the restaurant was lovely and it was overall the best place we could’ve chosen for my birthday dinner. My only issue is that we don’t live closer! Would come back here anytime, and couldn’t recommend to anyone enough! Thanks so much again.

google.author: Cícero Roniel
google.text: We had a wonderful experience at The Next Door. The food was excellent, with a menu focused on smaller plates that are actually very generous and filling, which made the whole experience even better. Everything we tried was full of flavor and well presented. The atmosphere is very pleasant and cozy, perfect for a relaxed and enjoyable meal. Great quality food, friendly vibe, and definitely a place we would happily return to and recommend.

google.author: Liv
google.text: Honestly, unreal. Highlights were lamb, scallops, duck and crispy pork. But it was all incredible. The pistachio ice cream was to die for also!!!

google.author: Lizzie Pendleton
