google.text: Booked a table for 10 celebrating a friends birthday lastnight. Food was amazing! 2 smalls plates (steak and prawns) with a bowl of olives was the perfect size portion for me. Excellent service, will definitely be back :)

google.author: Dewi Jones
google.text:
Booked a table for 2 this evening.
Fantastic food, (hog roast sharing platter pictured), and nice options to have food as mains or as small plates, relaxed vibe and friendly service. Will definitely come back and would recommend!

name: The Post House, Llandudno

google.author: Stephen Jones
google.text: Staff were very helpful and friendly. Room was clean and serviced daily. Bar was well stocked and service was efficient and helpful. Breakfast was excellent. All food cooked was perfect and fresh. Can highly recommend the Sunday roast dinner. Definitely be going back there.

google.author: Paul Page
google.text:
Fantastic place. Great price, the breakfast was well good and presented.
Note the hotel is very warm, understandable trying to keep a normal temp for a large building. The windows open and provides that balance. Rooms well presented and clean. We will be back.

google.author: Katie McGuinness
google.text:
Most of the other restaurants in town were rammed after the Llandudno firework display, so I thought I'd try eating at The Post House as it wasnt busy with plenty of free tables. I didn't realise it was a hotel. The building looked nice from the outside but the interior didn't match the exterior and was fumctional and dated inside.. Breakfast cereals were still out from the breakfast service, which shows the lack of care and attention in the place.

The guy behind the bar was really abrupt and unfriendly when I asked if food was to be ordered at the bar. (The answer's NO!) Drink options were generic lager. No proper beer.
Menu's small and a bizzare mix of burgers which don't come with fries, then bao buns and noodles.
I took my seat and was completely ignored by the waitress for about 20 minutes. It was like I was invisible. She took the order from an adjacent table who arrived well after me, so I can only assume they don't want the custom from people dining solo, or maybe it's a locals only place.
On leaving I heard another table ask why there was no seasoning or ssuce for their noodles and bao buns as they were very bland, so it was probably a lucky escape food wise!

google.author: Gayle Hobson
google.text: This place is brilliant.Got the room for a great price.Staff are brilliant John and Dominic were great nothing too much trouble. Central location few good pubs in the streets nearby.Room was fine breakfast was amazing .locals were all friendly and we had a laugh with the mayor hahaha.Would deffo recommend this place 100% and will deffo be returning loved this place

google.author: Calum Yorke
google.text:
Brilliant few days / nights at The Post House.
Great location, near everything you want to access during your stay.
The staff were great throughout but a particular mention to both Owain and John. Went out of their way to ensure we had a good trip and were a real pleasure to meet and chat to. Even the small things like bringing in some UNO cards for the kids, which went down well.
We will definitely be staying again in the New Year as we often visit Llandudno.

description: Warm B&B set in a Victorian house offering cooked-to-order breakfast, a lounge & a bar.

name: The Seahorse Restaurant

google.author: Anna R
google.text:
My partner & I had the pleasure of dining at this charming, family-run seafood restaurant, and it was an absolute delight! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with a warm and cozy atmosphere. The staff, clearly a close-knit family, were incredibly friendly and attentive, which added such a personal touch to the experience.

As for the food – it was simply delicious! The Cod was perfectly prepared, bursting with flavour. The seafood linguine was very tasty. The portions were generous, and you could really tell that everything was made with care and attention to detail. We had the Mussels to share & we couldn’t believe the amount we got! The cozy vibe and amazing food made for a memorable dining experience, and we will definitely be back, Highly recommend for anyone looking for great seafood

google.author: Steven Owens
google.text:
Great Service & Amazing Food

We recently revisited The Seahorse on a stay in Llandudno and it was just as good as we remembered from our previous visit (despite undergoing a change of owner)

The Set Menu offers a limited but good range of Dishes from 1-3 Courses at a very reasonable price.

The Service, Music and Atmosphere are all exceptional and this cosy restaurant is perfect for couples and small groups.

We definitely recommend this restaurant and a booking is usually advisable. We will most definitely be returning when we are next in the area.

google.author: The López Brothers
google.text:
This restaurant is a lovely place if you like fish. But there are also options other than fish, such as lamb.
We ordered various different starters and main courses. All were very tasty. If you take a starter and a main course, it will be enough for someone with an average appetite.
The staff were friendly and the prices were right, considering the freshness and good taste.
The only negative was the gratin dauphinois, which didn't look or taste very good.

google.author: Darren Dyke
google.text:
Welcoming staff, tasty well cooked food and reasonably priced.

The setting is comfortable and atmosphere welcoming.

The only critisim would be the lamb rump was a little tough and fatty, but still tasty.  I didn't mention anything at the time as it was still okay.

Overall it was a good restaurant which can be recommended.

google.author: Julian Johnson
google.text: A seafood focused restaurant near the pier in Llandudno. Set over 2 floors in a lovely Victorian building with the bottom floor set as in an intimate bistro and the top floor set as a more traditional restaurant (with an overuse of blue lighting). The menu looks appetising and fresh. The dishes were generally tasty though my partner found her fish a little overcooked. Presentation wise, the food is a little dated and staff are nice though a little inexperienced (looked a little nervous in fact). It's perfectly nice but given this is supposed to be the best seafood in town we were left a little disappointed. It is good value and has a limited but interesting wine list.

googleBusiness.businessName: The wild boar local seafoods and meats Restaurant

description: Market-fresh local seafood at downstairs bistro with church pews and Victorian-style restaurant.

google.author: Jason
google.text:
I came here based on recommendations from Google and friends, and it did not disappoint. The fish was very tasty, and the batter was perfectly crispy. The chips were crisp on the outside, although they were quite dense and heavy. The Coca-Cola portion was also quite small.

The staff were very friendly and accommodating to our requests, which made the experience even more pleasant. Overall, a very enjoyable visit, and I would happily return.

google.author: Lydia
google.text: We used to love it here! However, we won’t be back again. Asked for regular cod and chips to be given the most measly amount of fish (see picture) and a scattering of chips. Taste was ok but very greasy. Sorry to see what was such a lovely place go so downhill.

google.author: Simon Ashman
google.text:
My wife and I went out for a run in the car and ended up in Llandudno, we found a parking space and just up the road was Tribells fish and chips with their restaurant next door to sit in and eat. So we decided to go in and get some tea. Very nice spacious clean restaurant, my wife had steak and kidney pie with chips and gravy, and I had breaded fishcakes and chips. Both were delicious, lovely chunky chips, lovely fishcakes and lovely steak and kidney pie, we also had a pint of San Miguel each which was great. Great service aswell.
See you again soon, Thanks for a nice evening.
*sorry about the blurry pictures 🤦

google.author: Lisa D
google.text: We visited Tribells on a Monday night after finding that the chippy we had been intending to visit was unexpectedly closed! But very glad we stumbled upon Tribells. They cook their fish and chips in proper beef dripping, and it very much comes through in the taste. Absolutely delicious. Best fish and chips we've had in a very long time. Ham, egg, and chips wad also lovely (proper bits of grilled gammon, rather than the wafer ham you get in most places!)  Service was fine, portions generous enough for the slightly higher price point, lovely and relaxing interior. Overall, highly recommended and we would definitely visit again next time we fancy fish and chips in Llandudno.

google.author: Terry Hooper
google.text:
Tribells has a dine-in with a takeaway next door.
As it was November we dined-in.
We were going to opt for the 'Tray for 2' offer for £40 as it included a bottle of wine. They have two red wines, however we were informed that the offer didn't include the merlot. In view of this we orderd two regular fish and chips with one portion of curry sauce.
The fish and chips were a good size portion and very hot, more importantly they tasted very good, albeit a little greasy. Perhaps it's a trade off to ensure the food is very hot.
Access to the bathroom is via some steep stairs.
The service was very friendly.

google.author: Jimmy Cheng
google.text: We are veteran Vietnamese food goers and we were looking forward to have a nice Vietnamese meal before we go home the next day. We were left disappointed. First we found staff seem to have difficulty understanding us. Two orders were missing until we chased. Food was generally ok but portion is definitely on the small side. We had a few kids meals ordered but they were more like portions for infants than children, despite labeling as half portion (to adult). Soft drinks were served in large glass but only 3/4 full (just use smaller glass please). Finally, we found a fly in the pickled garlic jar (see photo) and we notified the staff, who took it away and asked us if we want another one. I guess you know how we felt at that point. Some of us adults were disappointed but the kids seemed to enjoyed themselves.

google.author: Bethan W
google.text:
Gorgeous little place in Llandudno, recommend a visit if you like Vietnamese food!

Food is spicy but very delicious! Portions of the pho are large, I took the rest home with me!
Taro bubble tea also really nice

google.author: Charlotte Wang
google.text: Love the interior decorations: green plants, sea shells and charismatic guitars on the wall. We ordered a papaya salad, pork stew, spring rolls and a classic rice noodle soup. Every dish is so flavourful, tastes like they all have got a heart. It’s a surprise for me to come cross such a beautiful Vietnamese restaurant here in Llandudno. Definitely recommend ♥️

google.author: Gigi N
google.text:
London price + extra payment charge + one  third of portion + 100% MSG

1.  Price - food are much more expensive than all the best Vietnamese restaurants I have had in London, costs £16.95 for pho with minimal ingredients
2. Extra charge - they do charge a fixed £1.2 per bill if you use a bank card or 5% if its an international card. We did pay a £1.2 using AE card, but they later blamed us for not informing them that it’s an AE card and demanded an extra 5% charge on top of everything, which is ridiculous.
3. Quality - we had pho and it left us very thirsty as it’s 100% full of MSG, and you could tell from the bland noodle that soup and noodle were cooked separately and unprofessionally. The few tiny slices of beef brisket were just absurd, and the generous amount of coriander as you can see from the picture.
4. Wooden chopsticks - we were only expecting a moderate expectations on quality given a very high price of food, however we were only served with wooden chopsticks that used in takeaways, not even proper cutlery.
5. Service - the staff seemed to have difficulty in accommodating 5 people and rejected us at first, and refused to combine a 3 +2 tables which was only one metre apart with no reason, not really an issue but it’s didn’t seem to be very welcoming.

If I could leave it a zero stars or negative I would. I’m giving two stars just to hope that the feedback doesn’t look too irrational that could be skipped by readers. Honestly this is the worst dine-in experience I have ever had in the uk, where you don’t feel welcomed, and served with a reasonable quality of food that could justify its price, and most importantly, being charged extra, and being blamed for paying AE, and being asked to pay further more. Honestly it made us feel robbed.

google.author: Naomi
google.text:
Recent review July 2024:
After really enjoying a date with my husband here, we brought the family on our recommendation for lunch. It's a small restaurant but the lady waiting was lovely in accommodating us and shifting the tables to seat our party of 7. They have updated the menu since we last visited, so it was great to see more veggie-friendly options. And the kids menu to have the half portion was good. We each ordered different dishes:  Phở, calamari, rice, noodles, stir fry and curry. Everything was incredible, we all thoroughly enjoyed our visit. Absolute gem of a restaurant! 🇻🇳🪷🍜

Old review Feb 2024:
Friendly and prompt service. INCREDIBLE food! Wouldn't recommend it you are vegetarian, but there is a tofu option for the dishes to make it work! 👍
🍜🍛

name: White Tower

google.author: Maddy Sha
google.text: Had an absolute blast at this charming Greek restaurant! The vibe was warm and inviting, the hospitality was top-notch - the staff were courteous and attentive. And the food? AMAZING! 🤯 The garlic mushrooms were TO DIE FOR 🍄, and everything we ordered was delicious. Highly recommend!

google.author: Michael
google.text: Atmosphere nice, location good and service was decent. If the price was lower would have given a 4* but the quality of food is not worth the price. Most main meals £20+  and come pretty dry, odd seasonings, and very average quality. Big portions though which is nice, but wouldn’t return if in Llandudno area (bill came to £30+ per person incl/ drinks).

google.author: John Charles
google.text:
We booked our table several hours before , and was worth it ( as it does get quite busy ).

Service staff are outstanding- nothing too much trouble , attentive , and courses arriving with good space between them.

Food is outstanding, freshly prepared by Petros , and his team .

Go Hungry as portions are traditionally Greek , and delicious.

Looking forward to returning to try other menu offerings .

google.author: Nicholas Hawe
google.text: We were advised to try here by the receptionist at the hotel we were staying at......and what a great piece of advice it was! Although they were busy, they made room for us (a table for 2), which was lucky as they then had to turn quite a few people away. The staff were really friendly and polite, even the young man who spilled a little wine when pouring it! He was so apologetic but really professional. The house red was lovely and good value for restaurant prices. Our starters and mains were just superb - really delicious and massive portions. I had the taramasalata and my wife had the spanakota, followed by a chicken in cream sauce for me and a bean stew called giantess for my wife. Wow! It was the best meal out we had eaten for some time, and all for under £80. We will be back soon!

google.author: MD
google.text: We had a fantastic midday meal here- the service was excellent and the food was so tasty-properly made Greek food. We enjoyed the chicken gyros which came with rice and coleslaw (an amazing amount of tender chicken), a homemade spinach and feta pie and fried halloumi with honey and pitta breads. Portions were very generous so we took what was left home. All finished off with  baklava and ice cream. Very reasonably priced and a cosy atmosphere. We’ll be back again for sure!

description: Unfussy outlet with outdoor seating whipping up Greek-style small plates, entrees & desserts.

name: Wildwood

google.author: Sophie Soh
google.text: Stopped by for the lunch set which is £13.95 for two courses. It is worth noting that the only full-sized pizza included in the set is the Margherita, as the other mains are pasta dishes. If you want a pizza with meat, you have to choose the "lighter" option which is a half-pizza served with a side salad. This is what we went for and it was actually a good amount of food. The pizza dough tasted delicious and the service was good. Overall, a decent spot to scratch the pizza itch in Llandudno.

google.author: Li koon
google.text: We went on a Sunday afternoon and could get a table without problem. The staff is really friendly and helpful. We ordered 4 pasta dish and all were good. It has a very family vibe and many families were having lunch there.

google.author: Ian Jones
google.text:
A truly lovely experience at Wildwood Llandudno.
I visited as a solo diner and was immediately put at ease by a wonderful waiter who took the time to seat me in a quiet, comfortable spot. It was such a small gesture, but incredibly thoughtful—it meant I could relax and enjoy my meal without feeling out of place.

I ordered the traditional spaghetti, and it was absolutely superb: simple, generous, and full of flavour, exactly the kind of comforting classic you hope it will be.

What really makes this place shine, though, is the team. Every member of staff I encountered was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. They create an atmosphere that feels both relaxed and well looked‑after, which is rarer than it should be.

Highly recommended—excellent food, excellent people, and a restaurant that truly understands hospitality.

google.author: Andrea Cervenakova
google.text: This is a nice, warm restaurant with welcoming staff. A lot of families were eating here when I came for lunch. Food has room for improvement, we ordered beef burgers and they were without flavour. Toilets are clean,but upstairs, take notice if you have a problem with the stairs. Parking is only on the street. They accept blue light card and generally prices are good.

google.author: tasha jarvis
google.text: Visited on a Friday night,  I hadn't booked and it was busy but they managed to get us a table for two. We both had lasagne which was really good. We also both order the truffle and cheese fries, if we knew it was such a large portion we would have just got the one but they were delicious. For dessert I had sticky toffee pudding and my sister had salted caramel profiteroles.

googleBusiness.businessName: Wildwood Llandudno Italian Restaurant | Pizza, Pasta & Grill

description: Stylish, modern restaurant chain serving European & international favourites, plus a kids' menu.

google.author: Melanie Roberts
google.text: Great little establishment which offers a taste of Thailands cuisine.  Thai green chicken curry is a must for those who like a little heat/spice.  The Pad Thal is also very enjoyable alternative with less heat/spice.  Great addition to Llandudno! Not lots of seating, so go early to be sure of seat. Nice karma when oriental music is playing in background.

google.author: Thansinee Hinsui
google.text: Delicious Thai food! I was having stir fry chicken with basil and fired eggs it was tasty. Great service and restaurant very clean. If you looking for Thai food take away please visit Wok`n' Roll Thai Noodles Bar.😊🤤👍🍽️❤️

google.author: Kyle Knight
google.text: Little hidden gem perfect for couples, rustic setup next door which is cosy! Small menu, which is actually great as the place is food quality focussed.. not like large restaurants that just push food out for a pay check. Food timing was quick but not too quick. Spring rolls were prob the best we've had, not too greasy nice and crispy! Even bought another dish to take back hotel

google.author: Yolthida Mi
google.text: I recently dined at Wok 'n' Roll Thai Noodle Bar with my daughter for the first time, and we were both very impressed. The service was excellent, and the food was served quickly. The overall experience was delightful, and I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for delicious Thai food.

google.author: JAYAN R
google.text:
Excellent find near to the Llandudno Pier. Such a wonderful noodle bar with limited menu but great food. We went during the lunch time with family and kids. We received a warm welcome and seated promptly. We had Chicken Fried Rice, Chicken Pad Thai Noodles and Thai Green Curry with Boiled Rice(Special of the day).

Highly recommended must try dish - Chicken Pad Thai Noodles and Thai Green Curry with Boiled Rice.

google.author: Kacie-Marie Williams
google.text: I came in with a friend for a catchup. The workers that served us were very nice. I believe his name was Dalj (apologies if incorrect) I had a caramel iced latte with the Cereal Killer cookie dough. Both were really delicious, honestly worth the money. I wasn't able to finish my food though, I was just too full. Highly reccomend if looking for a nice sweet treat in Llandudno. 😊

google.author: Emily Taylor Craig
google.text: Me and my partner love it here. You definitely get worth your money portions perfect size and definitely fill you up! The milkshakes are amazing!

google.author: Becky Twitchett
google.text:
I visited last week with my friend and daughter, and I'm really annoyed that I've found this place now because it was SO GOOD. I can't even explain how tasty it was. I ordered a cookie dough bake and little one had ice cream. Both absolutely delicious.

I've just done a home delivery order tonight and ordered pancakes and another cookie dough bake. Fair play to them at the shop, I made a mistake with the order and they rectified it straight away and gave me a milkshake for free when they didn't have to. Delivery was super fast as well.

Once again, I'm gutted I've found you as I will now be spending a fortune; all worth it though!

Thank you

google.author: Emma
google.text: Last month we were in Llandudno for work, and we came back again a couple of days ago for a short stay. As always, the food was amazing and the service was great. We were hoping to see the lovely hijaabi girl who served us last time, but sadly missed her this visit. Still one of our favourite places! 💛

google.author: Shona Clancy
google.text:
I’ve been wanting to try this place for a very long time. After a long day at work me and my partner decided to go for a little treat. I was really excited because I’ve heard so many good things about the desserts. I have an allergy to peanuts so I always make sure to ask before ordering any foods.
When we arrived, we looked at the menu. I was only going to order a strawberry and banana crepe however it said it comes with milk chocolate on top. I went to ask the lady at the counter if the milk chocolate would be safe for my allergies and if not I was going to ask to go without the chocolate. She then replied saying “we don’t do allergies” I was very confused by this statement so I questioned her on it. She then turns to who I assume was her boss and he then says to me “we don’t serve people with allergies”.
I understand there may be issues with cross contamination but if other businesses can have certain stations just for allergies then why can’t here.
In all honesty I felt so disappointed and upset. I know it’s only a dessert shop but seeing everyone else get to try and review just makes me feel left out.
It’s been around 2 years since I found out I was allergic to nuts and in those 2 years I have never experienced being turned away from somewhere.
Hopefully in the future this can change so I can have the opportunity to try some of these desserts like everyone else.

google.author: Nikolas Crawshaw
google.text: Came across Mollys whilst wandering around for a breakfast. Served by a lovely young lady, very pleasant and helpful. Breakfast was excellent and such a great price. Food was cooked spot on and so very fairly priced. Highly recommend. 😁 Very well run. AAA+

google.author: Kai Hermann
google.text: A dream of an english breakfast. I had a belly buster and my girl friend had the small breakfast. With two coffee it was round about 20 Pounds. The staff was very nice and we had our food 10 minutes after our order on the table. For the record ... my belly was busted! :)

google.author: ABPHOTOGRAPHY UK
google.text:
Well what can I say.. one of THE best breakfasts I’ve ever had. Lovely and hot. Great service. Fab prices. Safe to say, I shall return.

(Picture of mine and my husbands breakfasts, special and belly buster breakfasts)

This is a cash only business so please bare that in mind before attending, it is 100% worth the trip down

google.author: Paul Jones
google.text: We had a really enjoyable breakfast, staff are friendly especially the young lady who serves your table. Food was reasonably priced and was pipping hot. 10/10 no complaints  👌

google.author: LR
google.text:
Great food, great pricing, best value for money by far for a decent size breakfast.

Only issue is that it's cash only. The cash machine is only down the road oposite the police station (brown building with grey roof) just to the left of the train station.

Cannot fault anything with regards to food or service, it was brilliant should we revisit its first on the list for a breakfast!

google.author: Stephanie Foster
google.text:
Came here on a day out to Llandudno last month!

The menu sounded good so we tried it, quite quiet inside with not many people in there , staff were friendly though. Although, did tell her no soap in women’s toilet to which she said thanks and waited a while hoping she’d put some in but hadn’t been put in despite barely any customers so she would’ve had plenty of time to.

The food was quite good though! We were the only ones eating at the time so came out quite quickly.

I had the minted Welsh lamb burger which was really nice with nice chips! My mom had the Welsh lamb chops which were nice too but slightly dry, and my dad had an all day breakfast!

The food was nice and well priced! Tea was also nice.

Just a shame there wasn’t more people in at the time.

google.author: Lin H
google.text: Great friendly small bar in the centre of town.  The staff were very friendly and the place was clean. Really nice atmosphere with conversation easy as there was no loud music blaring. We visited early evening on a saturday. It was busy, but not rammed.

google.author: J C
google.text:
Sat in here one Wednesday afternoon. Great service but as we were the only customers most of the time no atmosphere. Very basic pub, clean except for the toilets that smelt.
Young lady serving was very good.
No food on when we went, I think I saw a board outside the previous Wednesday but no sign the next Wednesday.
Wont be bothering again as better pubs around. Good luck to them though...

google.author: Paul Phipps
google.text: Popped in for a Guinness which wasn't up to much. Staff were friendly enough. The place is in need of a good refurbishment. Nice flag stones on part of the floor. Pool table at the rear of the premises. Music being piped through was good. Ok visit.

google.author: Craig Taylor
google.text:
Fantastic little pub with a welcoming atmosphere as soon as you walk in. The bar staff where really pleasant and polite with big smiles on their faces, the premises are very clean and bright with music at just the right volume playing in the background. The toilets are your regular pup toilets, they are clean but a bit dated.
I ordered a Heineken which was served in a frozen glass ! Perfect ! My missus had a carling. Both pints where spot on. I will definitely be popping in again. 👍

google.author: Victoria Hawtin
google.text: We went to Pip and Oat last Sunday for their monthly roast . We had three courses and they were delicious. The atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable. The staff were friendly and attentive to all the diners,  for example , a young family were able to take their main and dessert away with them because their child was agitated, this showed us that the staff are more than happy to attend to their customers needs. We were very impressed by Pip and Oat and will definitely be back when we are in the area or will take a trip to visit again soon.

google.author: Andy King
google.text:
As someone who is not a vegetarian by a long shot—like, “my spirit animal is a mixed grill” levels of not vegetarian—I wandered into this adorable plant-based café in Llandudno on a whim. I figured, “Sure, I’ll nibble on some leaves, how bad could it be?” Reader…I was wrong. In the best possible way.

First off, the service was fantastic. The staff were so friendly they could probably charm a steak off my plate. The décor and atmosphere were so cosy and inviting I genuinely considered staying all day to read a book—if I’d actually remembered to bring one.

Then came the food. I ordered the breakfast ciabatta with meat-free sausages, bacon, scrambled tofu and a bunch of other plant-based magic. And I’ll admit it: it was seriously delicious. Like, suspiciously delicious. I briefly questioned my entire carnivorous identity.

Great prices, lovely staff, tasty food—honestly, what more could you ask for? Even this die-hard meat-lover left happy…and maybe a tiny bit converted. 🌱😄

google.author: Katy Gulliver
google.text:
The vegan teens loved it here first time so bought us over to try it. It's a nice bright friendly cafe. The food is not overly inspiring for the price point though it was very tasty ... On their first visit they loved the Philly cheese steak special....
All in all if you are vegan and in town it may be worth a look :)

google.author: chris pickering
google.text:
This place is all vegan, and lots of the menu items can be made gluten free. And to top it off they are dog friendly!!!!
Llandudno has some great independent cafes and this one is great. I had the vegan/gluten free breakfast in the morning and then the nachos for early tea!!!!

The cakes are delish!!!! And there is a gluten free option….

Highly recommended

google.author: Jonathan Relf
google.text: So good we came back within a week for more! Vegan butter chicken curry was delicious and an oat milk chai latte was delicious. Dog friendly and super friendly service with excellent cakes too. A must visit

google.author: Oliver Chun Long
google.text: Perfect lunch. The coffee and matcha were beautiful. The New Yorker toastie was delicious. Everything was very reasonably priced as well. We would have tried the cakes if we had more time, but we’ll definitely be back next time we’re in Llandudno!

google.author: R AY
google.text: Place an takeaway order for a Flat White, Americano, and a salmon cream cheese bagel. The service was outstanding! They offer a delightful variety of pastries, including pain au chocolat, cinnamon Danish, croissants, Portuguese egg tarts, and more.

google.author: Living The Dream
google.text: Myself and my elderly parents visited on the morning of Sunday 18th January and we found the service friendly and efficient! The drinks which included an Americano, Tea and hot chocolate were very enjoyable. The only downside for our group is we found the food menu to be a little pretentious! “Must normally get all the business suit lot in” was the comment from one of my parents! I would recommend this place for the drinks, and the food did look good so if you like ‘la de da’ food it’s probably worth a try!

google.author: Mark Lavender
google.text: I would not recommend buying gift vouchers for anyone from here. I bought £50.00s worth for someone for Christmas. They do not live in Llandudno, but liked the shop when they visited. They asked me to get them a cap with the vouchers, which I did. The cap was £19.50. They do not give change, so they made 50p from me. If they did this to someone everyday throughout the year, they would make £182.00 from us. I did not eat nor drink here, so I cannot comment on the quality or the service. I do not like being ripped off. I will not visit here for anything again.

google.author: Julie
google.text: What can I say except that Providero is the best café in town. The beans are freshly roasted & it’s evident in the taste of coffee every time. Beautiful ambiance, dog friendly & always delicious homemade food. They also have an amazing space upstairs for Yoga classes which are great! This is definitely my happy place 🫶🏻

address.fullAddress: 3 St George's Pl, Llandudno LL30 2NR, UK

google.author: Simon Jones
google.text: Should have read the reviews and gone to the chippy on the Pier. Went on a Thursday a few weeks ago, think anew girl was training but wasn't very enthusiastic. This is just a minor point. A board on the outside says probably the best fish and chips in Llandudno whilst the fish, chips and curry sauce I had were tasty the size of the "large" portion is microscopic and the price astronomical £17.50. What I can almost guarantee is that the chippy is the most expensive and has the smallest large portion in Llandudno, probably North Wales and that is being kind. Absolute rip off, go elsewhere!!!!

google.author: Kai Gardiner
google.text:
Don't give this place a miss!!!

Some of the best chippie chips I have ever had! Luffy inside, fresh, clean oil clearly used, and so crispy! Sausages were fresh and as good as a chippie sausage gets. My partner really enjoyed her fish. I feel like chippies all around the UK have reduced their portion sizes, so I can't judge this place for the size of their "large" fish. It wasn't large, but it was the largest of the options. Regardless, it was great, fresh, crispy, and soggy in the right parts. Curry sauce was banging too.

I was really surprised to see this place had a 1.7 rating after eating here. It doesn't deserve that based on the meal we had on Friday just gone. Service was superb too. The lad serving was really friendly and cracked smiles and laughs - proper British chippie service.

google.author: Zainab Khan
google.text: Very expensive and disappointing , they advertise fish and chips as a deal but they don’t sell them together, so it’s basically £15 a portion. Tiniest portion of fish I’ve ever eaten and seeping with oil, tasteless chips also way too greasy. My stomach was upset for the remainder of our trip!

google.author: gemma wilkinson
google.text: Popped in on Monday evening and what can i say! Everything was on point, the service, the fish and chips and the chip shop itself! it’s very well presented and the cleanliness is amazing! It’s nice too see a chip shop having fresh potatoes in the front window area so customers can clearly see they serve fresh chips as most chip shops nowadays use frozen! The service was lovley, the young female was very chatty and she even recommended activities too do whilst on our stay! Would definitely return when we’re back next year! Well done St George’s Plaice!

google.author: Stephanie Adams
google.text:
£9.40 for large chips and a jumbo sausage!!! Considering the 'large' chips were £4.95 I'm dumbfounded as to how they think charging another £4.45 for a sausage is acceptable. Absolutely awful food. Chips were definitely not what I'd call large, they were dry and hard so not freshly cooked as advertised. That bad my son and myself couldn't eat them.
Absolute waste of money I won't be wasting by frequenting here again.
I only wish I'd seen the reviews here first, and judging by the reviews I'm amazed they're still in business.
Avoid!

google.author: Jimmy Jaffa
google.text:
Let me begin with some unsolicited, yet desperately needed advice for the owners of this so-called establishment: sell the business immediately and find a career that doesn’t involve interacting with humans, perhaps mushroom farming in a remote cave. It’s painfully obvious you have no grasp of basic customer service, let alone how to run a hospitality venue.

We ordered breakfast, paid promptly, and sat down, all at the same table, so you’d think keeping track wouldn’t require a PhD. My wife and I received our food quickly, probably because the bacon was still trying to escape the pan, it was practically squealing. Sadly, that was the highlight. The rest of the food tasted like it had been seasoned by someone who mistook the salt shaker for a punishment device.

Meanwhile, our friends’ breakfasts vanished into the same black hole as your competence. After 15 minutes, we politely inquired, and were met not with an apology, but with an attitude so hostile it could’ve powered a war zone. Instead of admitting fault, your staff doubled down with a flimsy lie that collapsed under its own stupidity.

We requested a refund, which only seemed to inflame the already impressive display of arrogance and contempt. So if you happen to walk past this empty shell of a café and wonder why no one’s inside, it’s not a mystery. It’s because it’s operated by people with the social skills of a broken toaster and the professionalism of a reality TV contestant. Utterly, spectacularly, embarrassingly bad.

google.author: Karen Toner
google.text: Do not enter, so very many far superior and cheaper. Only has 1 star from me as I can't do zero! £4.95 for a cup of boiling water with a peppermint teabag on the side! It would have been £3.95 for regular tea but an extra £1.25 to have a non dairy alternative to milk to go with it. Terrible service, no tongs used on teabags just her hands which she didn't wash from having returned from out the back.  My friend had tea and milk was added for her ( not separate container) which was whole milk! Absolutely disgusting,  no wonder it was empty when we arrived despite tipping down with rain. Edit: Other customers requesting food were told none available, at 2pm! Nero's, the Lemon Tree and multiple other cafes are across the road, we should have gone over there to one of them where we've never had any complaints!

google.author: Victoria Brown
google.text: Hot chocolate with cream and marshmallows for £7.50? I don’t think this is reasonable. Pricing like this is just treating your customers like dirt so I really hope that teaches the owners a valuable lesson. We also ordered paninis (priced at £8.95) and they were tasteless.

google.author: Natalie Y
google.text: Shockingly poor quality food despite the “home cooked” advertisements, overpriced and slow service. Toilets are up two flights of stairs, unclean and no toilet paper. Best to take your money elsewhere.

google.author: Andrew Hilton
google.text: Food okay, but quite expensive for a seaside cafe. Two jacket potatoes and two regular (quite small) drinks for £35. And a confusing special offer that didn't seem to reduce the price. Won't be going back.

google.author: Kizzey Maclean
google.text: Amazing find! Staff were so friendly and food was incredible which is impressive considering the variety on the menu. The pistachio cake was 10/10, special thanks to the lady that makes them! Also, not just dog friendly, but dog welcoming, which makes all the difference for us. Will definitely return if we are in the area again

google.author: Andy Roberts
google.text: We were looking for somewhere different for lunch and I spotted this large statue of a pig on the sidewalk and we went to have a look at it and then noticed the Hambone food hall. I don't know why it's called a food hall as it's really a well stocked delicatessen and a nice cafe within the same premises. We had tea and a ham barm and it was quite large and nicely filled with ham. We ate inside but there was seating outside also. Judging from the amount of business they get it looks like they are doing very well. Nice place to have lunch with a huge range of meals available on the blackboard inside.

google.author: John Charles
google.text:
Popped For lunch , met by friendly helpful staff .
Chose salad box ( which were quite substantial, and delicious).
Made freshly to order  in front of you .

Made my dog very welcome - offering a sausage and some water .

Fantastic deli with some wonderful food
Offerings to eat in or take out . As well
As Daily specials .

google.author: Marc Wilson
google.text:
One word AMAZING ..  walked past the other year and thought we should try this year ..
GREAT service
GREAT food
GREAT draft beer ..
Food was to die for .. not usually a big buger fan but the Welsh lamb burgers where so tasty !!! Loved the side of chips !!! AND the beer was like being in Europe!!! Just need the heat to go with the cool glass ..
You need to TRY !!!

google.author: Georgina Dotchin
google.text:
We had the best breakfast at the ham bone this morning - the perfect way to finish a week In Llandudno. The chef, Che, and the whole team are so accommodating, friendly and efficient.
We also got some of their AMAZING scotch eggs to go. So so good and lots of different flavours to chose from!
Thank you for a wonderful end to our trip.

address.fullAddress: 5 St George's Pl, Llandudno LL30 2NR, UK

google.author: Gill Lovick
google.text: Serves a number of gluten free options, hard to find in many places. Lovely cakes, good choice. Very reasonable menu too.

google.author: Roger Mcphun
google.text:
Love this family run tea room(dog friendly, centreof town),beautiful decor, we were house hunting/viewing and this was our go to breakfast place ,great food ,wonderful staff .Just a lovely place to be .
We went down overnight mid week and popped in again for breakfast, still brilliant and will be on our regular visit list when we move

google.author: Simon
google.text:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

The Lemon Tree Tea Rooms in Llandudno is a delightful haven on a busy day. I tried the Welsh rarebit (perfectly topped with egg), and it hit all the right notes—creamy, savoury, and just what you need for a little pick-me-up. The charming Alice-in-Wonderland décor and friendly staff create a relaxed atmosphere where you’re free to sit wherever you like; just head to the register to order and your food will be brought over.

It’s clearly a local favourite—stylish yet unpretentious, with a diverse menu including sandwiches, toasties, jacket potatoes and homemade cakes. The staff were welcoming, efficient and professional, making this a quick but memorable stop. Dogs and gluten-free options are also catered for, which shows attention to detail. Overall, a perfect little retreat for a tasty break in Llandudno town centre.

google.author: DebbieAS68
google.text: Well what can I say, when they have a sign outside stating that not to worry if you are celiac we have separate fryers and dedicated work space for gluten free food , straight away I felt safe before stepping foot inside! I had a very nice gluten free full English breakfast,  it's a shame there was no sausage but there was hash browns, the best tasting I have ever had. Thank you for making me feel safe!

google.author: Stanley Spall
google.text: Lovely surprise to find right in the heart of the town! We were searching for a tea room, and just before we gave in and went to Greggs, found this gem. Food was excellent, service was quick, and all staff were fantastically friendly. Would highly recommend!!

address.fullAddress: 71a Conway Rd, Llandudno Junction LL31 9LT, UK

google.author: A K
google.text: Since opening the guys here at Brgr & Shakes have been smashing it. A great well priced menu, banging burgers every time with brilliant portions I might add. The milkshakes are unbelievable. Delivery to us can vary between an hour - 1 and 1/2 but collection within half an hour so depends on what’s most convenient for you. Food always arrives well packaged and hot. Great job guys!

google.author: Nazim Ali
google.text: Amazing food and excellent packaging. The burgers were fresh and juicy. Everything arrived perfectly packed. hot, can tell they care about quality from the food to the packaging. Definitely ordering again and highly recommended.

google.author: Haseena Ali
google.text: The chicken&smash burger was absolutely delicious and the chips were hot and crispy-definitely recommend coming here! We collected our order in store and they advised it wouldn’t take more than 15 minutes and they were true to their word. Everything was packaged nicely too

google.author: Christina Shaw
google.text: Amazing food! Service was incredible. I substitutes burger sauce for bbq on my burger and fries and they were great about it. A little mishap occurred and the fries came with burger sauce but before we were able to even open the box or drive away they came out and told us what happened and took the fries back and remade fresh and brought them back out to us would recommend for a good burger and loaded fries!

google.author: Catryn Blunden
google.text: Ordered here for the first time off just eat fair to say will NOT be ordering from here ever again. I wasn’t expecting the wrap to be spicy the only thing that was nice was the milkshake. Plus the driver was useless because he almost walked away without telling me the price. Honestly I had to call him back just to pay him next time I won’t.

google.author: Melissa Jane Kelly
google.text:
I opted for the chicken wrap, which proved to be both flavourful and well-balanced. The chicken was tasty and well-cooked, complemented by a fresh, vibrant salad including crisp lettuce, jalapeños, onions, red cabbage, and cheese. The sweet chilli sauce added a pleasant sweetness and gentle heat, tying the ingredients together without overpowering them.

The wrap itself—rolled tightly and securely, then wrapped in both cellophane and paper. This not only kept everything intact but also ensured the food stayed fresh and warm until eating, demonstrating attention to detail and care in presentation.

Bay Grill Kebab Shop in Craig Y Don, Llandudno, delivers a consistently satisfying takeaway experience, highlighted by quality ingredients and thoughtful preparation.

google.author: Karen Davies
google.text: Great food as allways,highly recommend the pizzas and the Donna meat with chips,fairly priced too so highly recommend using bay grill for a take out.

google.author: Chantelle Naomi
google.text: The staff were really friendly and the pizza was very delicious. I would definitely order from them again.

google.author: AMIR H
google.text:
The best Kofta I’ve ever had. Quite tender, spicy & juicy.
Highly recommended.

google.author: gareth roberts
google.text: Just Ordered tonight first time online very Impressed would Highly recommend the Chicken Doner meat , I had cabbage and mint yogurt  first time on the Donner meat 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

name: St George's Hotel

address.fullAddress: St George's Pl, Llandudno LL30 2LG, UK

google.author: Rajinder Shergill
google.text:
Amazing location with the view of the beach and pier. Nice comfortable rooms. Lovely restaurant capturing the view of the sea.
The Breakfast was great and included, lots of hot choices.
They were able to upgrade us to a view of the great Orme.
The high tea I purchased was alright,  I have had better.
Hotel is old, but updated except for some creaky floors.
Walking distance to the beach, pier, Orme, town and train.
Beautiful place to visit

google.author: Mark C
google.text:
Just back from a one night stay at this hotel and all I can say is a) I wish it had been longer and b) I'll definitely be coming back.

An incredibly reasonably priced, spotless and spacious room with a comfortable big bed to end the day and a tasty full English breakfast included in the price to start the next one. The hotel is quiet and well furnished, the staff are incredibly friendly, cheery and welcoming, and the restaurant and lounge are first rate with great service and beautiful views of the sea, the pier and promenade and the Orme.

No complaints whatsoever!

google.author: Kevin Thomas
google.text: We are currently on a 3 night Xmas break here at hotel. The hotel is amazing the staff are amazing the Xmas break was just perfect. Location is just where you want to be next to beach next to shops and next to promenade. It is our first time in Llandudno and will definitely return. However our 3 night package started with afternoon tea which was very disappointing tea was from a flask as was coffee and there was only cakes no sandwich or savory after a 4 and half hour drive was very disappointed. Also Xmas day the service was very very slow and the lunch was not an exciting Xmas lunch very bland. Also why have crackers on table if they not going to go bang there is no point. Those were the only 2 downfalls of the hotel the whole 3 day stay. Breakfast and other nights dinners service and choice was tremendous. But the main day Xmas lunch was a big let down. Would I come again definitely. I just think there need a few tweaks on Xmas day

google.author: Winston
google.text: Lovely hotel, fabulous staff. Young lady on reception who checked me in Friday 20th February was great, very helpful. Lovely room, great breakfast. Location is brilliant.

google.author: Dawn Morris
google.text:
Excellent location with everything you could possibly want within a few minutes walk. We were happy to leave the car and walk around the shops, enjoy the incredible choice of local eateries and explore the Great Orme. Finishing the evening with a walk on the promenade and fall asleep to the sound of the sea.
The room was lovely, the bed comfortable and the sea and mountain views are stunning. Breakfast was delicious and the staff were friendly and helpful.

description: Plush rooms, some with views, in a refined Victorian venue featuring a restaurant with sea views.

address.fullAddress: St George's Pl, Llandudno LL30 2NR, UK

google.author: Phil Crombie MTB
google.text: Stayed one night, had a twin room on floor 3. Room was clean, beds comfy, pillows comfy. Room decor is old and could do with an update but bathroom was modern with good shower.and hot water.towles and linen also nice.virw from our room was ok and wasn't you  noisy or anything.Parked round corner in town Hall car park for a fiver, but you can park outside hotel for 90min for free, handy to drop bags etc. there's a bar in the hotel and we got a free drink as a perk of booking with hotel.com. again most hotel has dated decor but it's all clean. There's a modern lift available to get to the 3 floors. Breakfast was included, was buffet style, so can help yourself to as much as you wanter, fresh and delicious full English/Welsh brekkie with some yoghurt,.fruit,.tea ,. coffee and juice.  Location is great, can be at seafront or main Street in less than 2mims Walk.

google.author: Michael Smith
google.text:
Zero Hot Water.  Valentine's weekend ❤️

Arrived went out had a fantastic day around Llandudno almost perfect for what it is, arrived back about midnight,  after checking in at 2.30p.m   after a coffee and chatting decided to have our showers to get ready for valentine's day aka a Shower,  had no hot water at all. So firstly girlfriend was fuming so we went to speak to the receptionist, who simply said nothing he could do,  that added fuel to the fire,  so not being able to have a wash my girlfriend was fuming so this was perfect valentine's atmosphere, creating not much sleep for either, my girlfriend decided to leave and go home first thing and she did, packed her bags once the receptionist had said nothing he could do and she was on the first train, leaving me alone, after running to the train station like a idiot first thing in the morning to try and restore our valentine day, I had breakfast alone then packed and checked out myself not continuing with the rest of our stay. Seems the message wasn't passed on because no one did anything. Being asked after my girlfriend had checked out did I want a different room, I said it's ok my girlfriend has already left no point.  Shame that couldn't have happened earlier really,

Like everyone says it's dated, breakfast was ok, toasters need updating as it's a joke waiting 10 mins for toast, could do with staff that are in this realm chap who greeted us and  was at the bar was decent. The only modern thing is the lift it's fairly modern and tells you the weather.

Called the hotel to see if they wanted to say anything and literally told they will have to speak to the boss couldn't say anything although was apologetic that's not resolved anything,

24 hours earlier I sent a email with no response also.

Id you're looking for a hotel in Llandudno there is lots of choice iv stayed at a few and for the same money can have a better experience.

Much love to all hope this helps anyone planning a trip.

google.author: P Thomas
google.text: The hotel is spotless, breakfast was awesome, plentifully.  Just don't expect to have shower or a wash the water pressure is nonexistent. Gentleman on reception is miserable not even a good morning ect.

google.author: Guy B
google.text:
Third year in a row staying here for an event we do in the town each year.

Very good value for money.

Great breakfast.

Lovely couple who own it and lovely staff generally.

We will be back!

google.author: Tracy Liptrot
google.text: The rooms were very dated . Spotlessly clean and traditional breakfast was fantastic . Staff always helpful and friendly. If the hotel had abit of a makeover it would be a definite comeback to xx

name: The Baytree

google.author: Gary Baggott
google.text: Fabulous hotel. Staff fabulous. Food fabulous not one complaint from group Excellent week. excellent place for access to all amenities. And hotel suitable for people with miner disabilities.

google.author: Michelle Midgley
google.text: Bed's were comfortable and clean. Shower pressure and temperature were both very good. Staff were very helpful. We were very impressed with the meals and the selection on offer. Would definitely recommend this hotel but not for families  as the rooms are too small unfortunately.

google.author: john briddock
google.text: Very nice hotel situated opposite the pier handy for the shops great food very helpful staff highly recommend

google.author: Jannet Keating
google.text: Arrived today for our 2nyt anniversary stay. Came to hotel at 2.45 to be told room not quite ready ok so we will wait not a problem. I messaged ahead to hotel to ask for a low floor room due to my motability we were given 218 went up in the lift couldn't go any further due to 10 steps. Go back and ask for another room without steps as requested which hotel sent a reply e mail to say they could accommodate this. So back to reception at 3.10pm porter sorting room still sorting room it's now 4.20pm and sat in reception  not a good start hope things improve watch my space. 17/8/25

google.author: K R
google.text:
We will definitely stay here again. The staff are so friendly and the food is fantastic. Really impressed!
We originally asked to move rooms from the one allocated as it was a little tired (other reviews mention the same room). Despite being fully booked, they were happy and helpful to re-arrange it for us and we were so grateful. It made for an unforgettable stay for all the right reasons. Thank you :)

description: Victorian property with bright rooms, breakfast and a lounge/bar, plus a restaurant.

google.author: Dominic Skillicorn
google.text:
Had a lovely weekend stay, the hosts were amazing, attentive and helpful. Did everything they could to make it a good stay.

The Breakfasts were generous had good ingredients and were well cooked.

Location wise it's fantastic, right round the corner from the front but far enough away to be quiet.

google.author: Sharon Price
google.text: Lovely clean rooms with great hosts. Breakfast with fresh produce. You must try the porridge with greek yoghurt and fresh berries.

google.author: Christine Brundrett
google.text:
My husband and I have just returned from a weekend stay at Audley Guest House.
If you are looking for somewhere that is very clean and comfortable with an excellent breakfast choice  and in a good location then this is the place to stay. Carol and Danny are lovely hosts and make you feel very welcome. Even home made cake on arrival which was yummy. Our room was good size, lovely and with everthing you need. Would not hesitate to return.

google.author: Carmen Redfearn
google.text: Carol and Danny are both welcoming and brilliant hosts,nothing is too much trouble. The location is great short walk to beach and amenities, breakfast outstanding great choice to choose from. Bedrooms beautifully decorated and clean and to top it of gorgeous home made cake when you come back after an afternoon stroll lovely

google.author: Liam Bancroft
google.text:
Just arrived home after  wonderful 2 night stay at Audley guesthouse. Carol was really warm and friendly, very helpful too with helping us with advice on where to visit and eat in the area.
The homemade cake she made and left in our room was a awesome and unexpected touch, that definitely shows she cares about her guests.
The room was immaculate, the breakfast was perfect. What more could you ask for! 100% would recommend anyone to stay, in fact I've already passed on a few of Carol's buisness cards to my family members!
Thanks again, loved it!
Liam and Lena

name: Beachside Guest House (BOOK ON OUR WEBSITE FOR DISCOUNTED RATES)

google.author: V K
google.text: A lovely guest house with close proximity to Llandudno pier and promenade. Room 1 (Superior Pier View Room) was great for our two night stay. Friendly staff, good breakfast and a lovely beach theme throughout the premises. We booked directly on the Beachside Guest House website as prices are cheaper.

google.author: Peter Peczek
google.text:
Friendly host, nice decor and great location.
I was probably not the usual guest as I stayed at Beachside as a part of my business trip rather than holiday break.

Place is very cozy and clean with host going the extra mile to make your stay very comfortable and enjoyable. Thank you Dave.
Nice beech theme decor makes you feel good and very tasty made to order breakfast compliments your stay.

One little thing I found was the shower temp controller knob was missing a lever part which made it really hard to adjust (I’m not a weak person) there was also an empty shower gel pouch in the shower tray probably left by previous guests.

Other than that perfect place which I am planning to visit again.

google.author: Claire Hamer
google.text:
A lovely b and b in a great location with friendly and helpful owners. The whole building is decorated and furnished beautifully. The breakfast was tasty and served quickly. There’s a car park at the back of the hotel which is very useful to have access to. We would return again.
When comparing to other Llandudno bed and breakfasts that charge a similar room rate, two improvements would be to have fresh drinking water on the tea tray in the bedroom because not everyone drinks hot drinks and to have one type of fresh pastry on offer at breakfast. 😊

google.author: Sylvia Walker
google.text: The owners Cheryl and David are the nicest people you will ever meet. Their gust house is spotlessly  clean. The breakfast is excellent.  I cannot rate this place high enough

google.author: Andrew Walton
google.text:
Nestled amongst the Victorian houses and hotels of Southern Parade is this wonderful B&B. The owners David and Cheryl go out of their way to make guests feel relaxed and at home.
Decked out in a beach seaside theme throughout, it also pays homage to Llandudno’s entertainment history by feature walls in the dining room with delightful programs, posters and memorabilia of the town’s famous pier and Palladium.
We were in Room 11 on the third floor. The view is of the town and distant mountains towards Conwy. Delightful decoration, en-suite with a lovely comfy bed; hospitality tray including hot chocolate and biscuits; hairdryer and T.V.
The front of the hotel overlooks the War Memorial, beach and pier.
Breakfast included, see further note below, is delicious.
The house was a miners cottage, do be prepared for a number of stairs as there is no lift. Chairs are provided to rest on landings if needed.
I recommend Beachside and would certainly stay here again.

googleBusiness.businessName: Beachside Guest House (BOOK ON OUR WEBSITE FOR DISCOUNTED RATES)

name: Belmont Llandudno

google.author: Howard Thorp
google.text:
We only had a one stay at this wonderful hotel. The welcome and service from the staff throughout our stay was exceptional, they offered a real customer service experience.
The hotel was absolutely beautiful with rooms made up to a very high standard. Within your room they offered every item you can think of, even some binoculars to gaze out over the bay.
The morning breakfast was also high end with a wonderful selection of options.
Also we can recommend the sea view rooms, it's so nice to wake up to stunning views.
It's definitely worth a trip to see this lovely part of the world.
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

google.author: David
google.text: We’ve just had our 2nd stay here and we’ll be back again in the near future no doubt. The staff are great, always chatty and pleasant. The rooms are spacious, modern and we had a comfy bed. We were blessed with nice September weather and were able to have some drinks on their sun trap terrace at the front, overlooking the promenade / pier area, before heading off to a comedy gig at the nearby theatre. Breakfast was cooked to order and the staff suggested we take another coffee outside to enjoy the sun. Fabulous.

google.author: Georgia Gibbons
google.text: just got back from belmont had fantastic time .staff were amazing especially jenny .there was myself my daughter and my autistic grandson .jenny was amazing nothing was to much trouble. they were short staffed but jenny was so organised she took orders for breakfast. she served breakfast she cleaned has she went along .managed reception and still managed a smile.  she's an absolute ascent

google.author: Karen Powell
google.text:
Stayed one night as I needed a break but we will definitely book again
Room was beautiful, spotless and comfortable
Very quiet too
Great views over the bay
Loved the little touches in the room
Definitely recommended

google.author: Ana Adrasta
google.text: Rooms could have been maintained well. It felt damp and the carpets were stained. Also the bathroom was very small. However the bed was comfy and the view from the balcony was great.

description: Informal rooms, some with balconies, in a relaxed hotel offering sea views & dining.

name: Bodysgallen Hall (National Trust)

address.fullAddress: The Royal Welsh Way, Bodysgallen Ln, Llandudno LL30 1RS, UK

google.author: Peter Seaman
google.text: We had a wonderful 4 night break returning yesterday. Everything was excellent. We particularly appreciated the service provided by staff in the Spa Centre who helped my wife accessing the pool: she is visually impaired. We strongly recommend Bodysgallen hotel.

google.author: Sarah Bartlett
google.text: Went for festive afternoon tea. We were the only people in the afternoon tea room. It’s located in a 16th century wing with very traditional decor. There was a haunted feel about the place and for the most part, we were alone without any staff waiting on us. I think they forgot about us. Before leaving, we weren’t even sure where to pay. The food was nice but not worth the money we paid.

google.author: Chaoran Wang
google.text: A lovely place to stay and relax. The staff were really friendly and nice. The cottage is nice and cozy. The whole place is an historical site, a very nice place to experience the british country heritage.

google.author: Jo Dancey
google.text:
A lovely country hotel tucked away in a quiet spot near Llandudno. We had a cottage suite which was roomy, quirky and charming. Sadly the beds were so uncomfortable and the couch in the lounge section had long had its day!, so uncomfortable. The breakfast was nice but service was slow and muddled at times (think this was due to foreign staff with limited English)
For the high price a tad disappointing to be honest. However a great spot to explore North Wales… Portmeirion, Conwy etc

google.author: Matt Aldridge
google.text:
A great hotel, very traditional, it's like going back in time. Staff were great. Breakfast was decent, but not spectacular. We can't recommend the restaurant, happy to pay £££s if it's decent, but it was bland, all for show, but very little taste. Disappointing. You get a better meal out in the town for half the price, and full of flavour (try the Seahorse). We found the 12.5% service charge on everything a cynical attempt to drive up prices, drinks over priced too, plus the service charge on top.

My wife used the Spa and she was very complimentary with the treatment as service.

All in good, but don't think you are getting a good deal on the restaurant, that bits is a let down and could be much better... Or charge less and do something with more flavour and less flounce!

description: Luxe parkland hotel with refined rooms, suites and cottages, plus a spa and upscale dining.

name: Branstone

google.author: Karen Whitworth
google.text: The b and b was spotless, cleanest one we have stayed in, the shower was very good, and so was the breakfasts.The owners were friendly and welcoming. Will defiantly stay there again.

google.author: Trevor Knight
google.text: Excellent the house and room were spotless the breakfast really good , the stay Is good value for money, another great thing is the location a very short walk to the town centre and beach. this was our second year at branstone and hopefully we will visit next year, dawn and Jason are excellent hosts

google.author: Alan Cooney
google.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay with hosts Dawn & Jason! They were friendly, helpful, and very professional! It was obvious they really care and take a pride in giving guests an enjoyable experience from moment of arrival to time of leaving! Impressive breakfast cooked to order! Nice decor throughout! Very clean! Free on street parking! Good value tariff! Look forward to a repeat booking & telling all our friends!!!

google.author: Helen Pickford
google.text:
We have just had the most lovely weekend in Llandudno staying at The Branstone. What a fabulous place.
Jason and Dawn are excellent, friendly hosts who can’t do enough for you.
Rooms are beautifully decorated and spotless  everywhere and the breakfast was amazing. So much to choose from. Full welsh breakfast cooked to perfection and again nothing to much trouble if there was something you wanted that wasn’t on menu they would happily accommodate it if possible.
The guest house is perfectly situated for all amenities and plenty of restaurants near by.
We will definitely be back when visiting Llandudno again . Hopefully very soon.

google.author: Chloe Austin
google.text: Dawn and Jason were lovely hosts, very friendly and accommodating. Room was spotless and absolutely perfect. Easily one of the best breakfasts we’ve had and will definitely be coming back again. Could not fault our stay.

description: Victorian-era guesthouse offering low-key rooms with bathrooms, plus free WiFi and hot breakfast.

name: Britannia Guest House

address.fullAddress: 15 Craig Y Don Parade, Llandudno LL30 1BG, UK

google.author: Steve Mattocks
google.text: James and Jackie are brilliant hosts. Nothing is to much for them. From their welcome to their good bye they give 100%. Our room was excellent. Our breakfasts were just gorgeous. This was our first stay and we have already booked our next visit. They are both passionate about their jobs and their knowledge of Llandudno is first rate. Thank you both.

google.author: Lee Johnson
google.text: Had 3 nights in the guest house over the fireworks and remembrance weekend and yet again we have had an exceptional stay!" James and Jackie are fantastic and nothing is too much trouble and with there brilliant breakfast makes the stay superb

google.author: Pam Cotterill
google.text: There's nothing we didn't like about this lovely accommodation. It's the best breakfast we have ever had, and we have had lots of breakfasts in different establishments. James and Jackie gave us a very warm welcome, and we even had a free upgrade, from a sea view room, to a large seaview room, which was fantastic. The whole place is so clean, and there was nothing too much trouble from them. Jackie has a passion for her front garden, resulting in beautiful coloured blooms, which makes the welcome even nicer. It's about 25/30 minutes walk into town, but a regular bus service runs at the back of the property, which is a great bonus! We didn't have trouble getting parked outside the property on the road. We would definitely go back to this welcoming guest house, and will highly recommend it. Well  done and thank you James and Jackie.

google.author: Jean Barugh
google.text: Just come back from our first , but definitely not our last stay in the Britania. Room wise , we couldn't have asked for more. Sea view, impeccably clean and comfortable. Food wise, breakfast was delicious, and host wise, Jackie & James , very friendly . We couldn't have asked for more. Thankyou both .

google.author: Carly Woosnam
google.text: Great welcome. Both Jackie and James were superb hosts. Beautiful room with a stunning sea view. The breakfast was delicious. Already booking again .

description: Refined guesthouse offering country-style rooms with free WiFi, plus full breakfast.

name: The Broadway Hotel

google.author: Karen Capewell
google.text:
We are currently staying at this hotel as a couple with a small dog. I cannot speak more highly of the service being received, the high standard of cleanliness in the bedroom, en-suite bathroom and the other public areas.

The breakfast this morning was lovely, plenty of choice and the full English was delicious and well presented. The waiter was very polite, friendly and attentive to our requirements.

The gentleman on reception when we arrived was also polite, friendly and attentive. We had a slight ‘hiccup’ upon arrival but this was resolved professionally and immediately.

We weren’t expecting housekeeping services this morning, therefore,  we were delighted to return from a walk to see that the room had been serviced.

I cannot speak more highly of this hotel and its staff. Very reasonably priced, recently decorated (we stayed here 10 years ago when it was badly in need of a refurbishment), comfortable, warm and accommodating - central to the seaside shops, retail shopping park and the pier - all within walking distance.

We will definitely return in the future.

Thank you to the staff for your hard work and for making us feel so welcome.

google.author: Chel O'Hare
google.text: We spent 3 nights at this hotel, it was very well kept, the room was huge with a seating area under the window. Huge TV on the wall. Big clean bathroom with enormous shower. The bed and pillows were very comfortable. The heating was on long enough that the room was never cold. The lovely chap who delt with us was really friendly throughout. The food was good both hot and cold. There was a spacious bar. There are a few steps to get to reception, we did see a lift in the dining room to other floors, but as we didn't use it im not sure what floors it covered. Very close to the train station, retail park, town center and the beach. I would definitely return to the Broadway Hotel.

google.author: Karen Chazen
google.text:
I had a lovely stay here. Great value for money very clean and comfortable.  Lovely breakfast.
Staff very helpful indeed helped me out with something without hesitation.

google.author: Steve Jackson
google.text: Just returned from a night at the broadway hotel in llandudno.  Room was great, freshly decorated, very clean, a lovely bay window and spacious bathroom.  Breakfast was good and service was prompt and friendly.  Added to this exceptional value and dog friendly in a central location with nearby street parking, whats not to like!  Thank you for our stay we will return soon.  Highly recommended.

google.author: cheesekake 101
google.text:
A pleasant stay. I stayed here for my birthday treat with my dog. The host was very friendly and welcoming, and helped me with my heavy bags.

Aesthetically the room isn't perfect, but it was warm, clean and spacious.

The breakfast for the next 2 mornings was delicous and filling.

If you don't mind a room that's not perfect, but has a good location, clean, with friendly staff at a good price then this is the hotel for you.i myself will definitely  be back.

description: Classic rooms in a Victorian hotel offering free Wi-Fi access, plus a restaurant and a bar.

name: Bryn Derwen

address.fullAddress: Bryn Derwen, 34 Abbey Rd, Llandudno LL30 2EE, UK

google.author: Wendy Briggs
google.text: Just returned from a few relaxing days at this fantastic hotel, thanks to our hosts for making our stay so enjoyable,  the room was spotless, and had everything you could need, including complimentary bottles of water and fresh milk ,the bed was also super comfortable.  Situated in a quiet location it has its own private car park which was very handy. Breakfast was delicious and Lynn and Mark were the most friendly and helpful hosts. We will definitely be back again, this hotel is a true gem, and a special "thanks bab" from the midlands !

google.author: Margaret Broadhurst
google.text: Stunning B&B, beautifully presented. Loved the original stain glass windows as you enter, Amazing breakfast 😋. Loved all the little touches in our room. Would highly recommend staying here. Lyn and Mark were the best and couldn't do enough for you. We certainly will be back.

google.author: Gerd Hulsmann
google.text: Lyn and Mark are providing unmatched hospitality, and going the extra mile for their guests. The breakfast is outstanding and everything is spotless, including the rooms. Parking is easy on the roadside and on the private carpark. And we could not believe how quiet the area is at night. We slept with windows wide open but couldn't even hear any traffic. Everything is nearby and in walking distance! We definitely will be back again!

google.author: Daniel Martin
google.text: We had a lovely stay for a few nights, rooms are spacious and exceptionally clean. Hosts couldn't have been more friendly and helpful and the breakfast was delicious! We will definitely come back to visit!

google.author: Mark Dodd
google.text: My wife and I had a weekend break at this lovely guest house. Hosts Lyn and Mark were great. Room was spotless with a really comfortable bed. So thoughtful to give guests  room numbered bottled fresh water and milk in a fridge. Lovely choice of breakfast options and everything was so fresh particularly the fruit. We were so impressed and had a great stay we have already booked for next year!

googleBusiness.businessName: Bryn Derwen B&B with Private Car Park

description: Stately guesthouse offering airy, traditional rooms with free Wifi, plus full breakfast & a bar.

name: Bryn-Y-Môr Hotel

google.author: Kristy MacDermaid
google.text: My husband and I enjoyed our time here immensely! The views from the patio are stunning, the hosts are so very friendly and helpful, the room we stayed in was lovely, the breakfast everyday was delicious! Already planning to book here again next time around. Thank you so much Lisa and Darin

google.author: Paul Woodhouse
google.text:
This is the perfect place to stay in Llandudno. It is on a quiet road opposite the entrance to the pier. The views across the bay are stunning. The whole hotel is attractively decorated and very clean. Breakfast includes a fresh fruit option as well as a full cooked breakfast. We really enjoyed this. Lisa and Darren are really welcoming and helpful hosts. Nothing is too much trouble for them. They create a very relaxing environment.

A final thought, if the weather is kind, the newly refurbished terrace is the perfect place for a drink in the afternoon.

google.author: Duke David Hart (DTR)
google.text: Fantastic staycation. My room was very clean and tidy. Hosts Daren and Lisa are always happy to advise local eateries and places to visit and things to do locally. The breakfasts are a perfect start to the day. The honesty bar is very reasonably priced with a good selection of drinks and snacks. I should've booked a longer stay. I will be back.

google.author: Ashleigh Farrell
google.text:
Our stay at Bryn-Y-Mor was terrific! The breakfast was exceptional, featuring fresh fruit and a deliciously cooked meal that set us up perfectly for the day. The 5-star breakfast was a highlight, and the room was spotless, reflecting the hotel’s high standards for cleanliness.

The shower was a standout feature—an overhead rainfall head plus a smaller handheld one, perfect for washing hair. The staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating, making us feel genuinely welcome throughout our stay.

We were lucky enough to have a sea-view room, and it was stunning—waking up to that view felt like such a treat. The room itself was lovely: comfy bed, fresh coffee, clean, and beautifully presented. The location is ideal, with the beach right on the doorstep and the town centre within easy walking distance. There are plenty of great restaurants nearby, too.

Bryn-Y-Mor is a lovely couples’ retreat—peaceful, relaxing, and perfect for a romantic getaway. One of the standout features is the fantastic value for money. We felt so lucky to have stayed there and will be coming back!

google.author: Broccoli Nguyen
google.text:
We had a fantastic experience at Bryn Y Mor Hotel in Llandudno. The hotel's prime seafront location offers stunning views of Llandudno Bay and the Great Orme. Our room was spotless and comfortable, featuring a walk-in rainfall shower and all the necessary amenities.

Breakfast was delightful, served in a dining room overlooking the bay. The staff were exceptionally welcoming and attentive, making our stay even more enjoyable. Being an adults-only hotel, it provided a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. With its proximity to the pier, promenade, and local attractions, Bryn Y Mor is the perfect choice for a tranquil seaside getaway.

description: Classic rooms with free WiFi at a Victorian hotel offering a lounge, a bar and a beach-view terrace.

name: Buile Hill Holiday Flats

address.fullAddress: 46 St Mary's Rd, Llandudno LL30 2UE, UK

google.author: Paul Lisle
google.text: This was our second visit to Buile hill . We stayed in the newly refurbished flat 1 on the ground floor . We were there for the scooter rally weekend the building as great off road parking. The owner was very helpful & friendly, overall a great stay .

google.author: Heather Oates
google.text:
The flats are located in a central location on a quiet road. Approx 15 mins to the West  Shore and maybe the same to the north shore and bottom of the Great Orme.
I stayed in flat 3 on the first floor.
It contained a shower room, kitchen/diner/lounge area and a twin bedded room with a wash basin.
There was plenty of hanging space and drawers.
The whole place is exceptionally clean and well maintained. They are fully equipped with everything you need for your stay. Toiletries, kitchen cleaning equipment and a small manual carpet cleaner.
The hosts are friendly and welcoming. Dogs are most welcome, they even have a blanket and biscuits left for them. Nice touch.  There are 2 small lawns areas for the dogs to have a run around but one of open to the road.
There is on site parking but really only enough room for 2 cars. There is free roadside parking.
I will definitely be returning next year.

google.author: Kirst Parky
google.text: Excellent.! The apartment we had was bright, light and modern. Everything in there you would need for a self catering stay.
