In fantastic location five mins from train station and town centre. Set in lovely garden with parking available. Owner was friendly and helpful will definitely return

google.author: Mumble Bumble
google.text: Lovely stay! Janet and Kevin were so welcoming. Holiday apartment was modern and perfect for our needs, everything was catered for. Nice quiet location yet very central to town. Definitely be booking again next year.

google.author: Geoff Jones
google.text: A lovely old Victorian home  know split into several large flats,the living room was lovely with all fairly new units the bedroom was fitted with two single beds which I found comfy,if I had a critique point it would have to be the bathroom ,being in our late seventies the narrow space which the toilet was fitted was somewhat difficult to negotiate,, on the other hand the shower was commodius but was lacking any kind of hand support which we are so used to at home ,only a simple fix would make a huge safety improvement. We were very gratefull to have a facility to charge the batteries for my mob scooter

description: Modern self-catering holiday flats in a 3-storey detached house on residential street with parking.

name: Burleigh House

google.author: Sean Toon
google.text: Just had a weekend here, can't fault it. Steve & Julie are lovely hosts,nothing to much trouble for them. Even received a text saying room was ready early if we'd like to check in.clean rooms with everything you will need provided, and a great breakfast.Good location as well, everything within walking distance. Every room this weekend booked by returning guests which says something about the place/hosts.

google.author: heidi docherty
google.text:
Our second visit here in a month
Julie and Steve are the perfect hosts .Nothing is too much trouble for them .The rooms are great ,comfortable clean and very welcoming.I would definitely recommend a stay here .Cannot wait for our next visit.Thanks Julie &Steve ⭐️

google.author: M a r y a n n R o s e
google.text:
Ten stars! ⭐️
Steve and Julie are AMAZING! I stayed (4) nights and I have no complaints! Breakfast was better than at 5-Star hotels. They packed me a lunch because I left at 8AM and would miss the breakfast. How thoughtful!!!

Small room had everything I needed! I was working, and they let me use their office. They treat you like family, and it’s why they have many repeat customers. Who stay multiple days.

WiFi was fast! Shower was brand new and had great hot water, good pressure. The location is PERFECT! It’s on the nicer, more luxurious side of town. Close to the pier, close to Great Orme. Really great value, too. I paid GBP 70, or USD $93. I could go on and on! Would absolutely stay here again in a heartbeat! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

google.author: Dawn i
google.text:
I stayed in room 1.
Lovely Bed & Breakfast.
Steve & Julie are great hosts and make sure all your needs are met.
Very friendly and attentive without being overbearing.
Clean and well maintained building.
Comfortable bed.
Walk in shower.
Wonderful Breakfast.
Close to all amenities,  yet nice and peaceful.
Very reasonably priced.
Always book direct.
I won't hesitate to stay here again and will recommend to anyone looking to stay in Llandudno.

google.author: Marisa Raffle
google.text:
Burleigh house is a wonderful place to stay. The rooms are beautiful, clean and tastefully decorated. They are a really good size too. Steve and Julie (the owners) are so friendly and very knowledgeable of the area. You will get a very warm welcome from them. The breakfast is wonderful and very tasty.
Very much recommend if visiting Llandudno.

description: Relaxed guesthouse offering subdued rooms with iPod docks and free WiFi, plus full breakfast.

name: Iris Hotel

google.author: Paulina legenc
google.text:
Overall, I would not recommend staying at Hotel Irys. The only thing that will definitely stay in my memory is the great location, but unfortunately the hotel itself was a big disappointment.

After picking up the keys at the reception, I went to the room with my pregnant wife. As soon as we entered, we were hit by a strong smell of marijuana that made it impossible to stay in the room. I went back to reception to explain the situation and, to their credit, the staff reacted quickly and gave us another room.

However, after moving to the second room we discovered that there was no internet access at all. There was no Wi-Fi and even the mobile signal in the room was so weak that we couldn’t use our own mobile data.

The third and worst issue was the temperature in the room. The heating was turned up to the extreme — it felt like you could fry eggs on the radiator. There was no way to regulate the temperature. The heating stayed on full blast all night, so the only way to sleep was with the windows open and a fan running.

After a second conversation with the staff, we were told that they do not guarantee internet access in the rooms and that the signal in the area is weak. Regarding the heating, we were told that many guests complain about rooms being too cold, which is why the temperature was set that high.

To be fair, the rooms themselves were clean and the bed was comfortable, so sleeping itself was fine. However, the overall experience at this hotel was poor.

google.author: Gareth Wynne
google.text: Really nice hotel - good size room and very clean. Complimentary continental breakfast included in the price and it was very nice. Had a room with a sea view which was a bonus. The only thing I could see that needs improving is a double glazed window in the room - I’m not sure if it applies to all the rooms, but the rooms on the 4th floor have single glazed windows, so I’ve knocked a star off for this. Overall good value for money though and I would return.

google.author: Prashamit Roy
google.text: Location is really great, however they gave the rooms not in the hotel. The rooms were in different building beind the actual hotel. Rooms are really clumsy and heater was also uncontrollable. Hence, rooms turned out to be very hot whole night. Windows were totally stuck and couldn't be opened at all. Complimentary breakfast was fine. Overall experience would be good if the rooms alloted would be in the actual hotel. Also there was no mention in anywhere that the rooms won't be in the actual hotel.

google.author: Tesin T George
google.text:
I had a very disappointing stay at Iris Hotel room 406 for 4 nights in Llandudno. There was no privacy in the room because there was a large gap beneath the door, so everything happening inside could be clearly heard outside. The room condition was poor overall. The sliding door of the wardrobe was broken, and the room was not very accessible.
The heaters were not working, and even after complaining to the reception, no action was taken. This made the stay very uncomfortable.
Breakfast was also extremely disappointing. The options were very limited: eggs, cornflakes, milk, bread, yoghurt, and two types of juice. This was far below expectations.
Overall, this hotel did not meet basic standards of comfort or service. I would not recommend staying here.

google.author: parth patel
google.text:
I would advise anyone reading the reviews before making a booking to reconsider. The service was extremely disappointing, and the staff behaved in a rude and unprofessional manner. Due to poor management decisions, guests were asked to vacate the hotel by the following morning. This was communicated by sending individual letters to each room, a copy of which I have shared in the photos.
Additionally, all the rooms had a strong, stinging odor that made it difficult to breathe upon entering. The carpets were damp and wet, and there was visible mould present, raising serious concerns about cleanliness and hygiene. Overall, the experience was highly unsatisfactory, and I would not recommend this property to others.

description: Relaxed, seafront townhouse offering casual quarters, plus a spa, quaint dining & free breakfast.

google.author: Richard Haynes
google.text: Friendly welcome from the staff and a nice restaurant in which to eat. A good and extensive gluten free menu. Fair prices. Great customer service and tasty food.

google.author: Lyndsey Hunt
google.text: Great variety of food options for vegans and if you are gluten Free too. Staff friendly and quick service.  Food tasted amazing I had fish less fingers and chips and they were so yummy. My finace had fish and chips and he said they were really good. A bonus was we were allowed to bring our dog in with us witch was a bonus, luckily she is well behaved dog so not a problem.  All in all if you are near the area I highly recommend.  10 out of 10 from us, we will definitely come back more and more.

google.author: James Norman
google.text: Food was nice enough. But £33.50 for 2x cod and chips and 2 cans of coke is pretty steep.  It wasn't anything special. People were friendly enough but the place inside looks pretty dated and needs a bit of a spruce up. The customer toilets also needed a bit of a clean.

google.author: Nicola Ward
google.text:
My second visit to Barnacles. A wonderfully inclusive menu. As a Vegan I'm left wondering why other food establishments can't get it right too. Barnacles ✅️✅️✅️✅️✅️
Great choice of light meals, chippy and hot dinners. Desserts and cake 🍰
Staff friendly and attentive.
Warm and welcoming.
Bonus points for being dog friendly 🐕

google.author: S P
google.text: Quite possibly the best fish & chips I’ve ever had! Everything was cooked fresh, the fish was battered just right and chips were piping hot, highly recommend!

google.author: bill
google.text:
PERFECT ice cream place!!

Lots of gluten free options, dairy free options, vegan vegetarian etc!

Great selection of fun toppings, cones and flavours. Lady at the counter was so lovly, told us some trivia on the history of the building and was generally a delight to talk to to.

If your in Llandudno THIS is the place for ice cream

google.author: TerriLee Lindley
google.text: The most wonderful ice cream shop filled to the brim with fun flavours... they even do ice cream for dogs, which was loved by our pup. The shop was very clean, with friendly staff. If you're ever in town you should check it out. A must for ice cream lovers like us. Thank you xxx

google.author: GaryOakley
google.text: We were in Llandudno walking Great Orme and were looking for a quality ice cream parlour. After a quick search Dollop came up as the best and the reviews were not wrong! The flavour choices and quality of the waffle cone were excellent as was the service with a smile. We will make definitely be back on our next visit to the town.

google.author: Julie Palin
google.text: Fantastic ice-cream shop. The owner was lovely and the ice-cream was delicious. Prices were about right but the more scoops you had the better value it was!! Would definitely recommend 👌

google.author: Jenny L
google.text: Tried the Very Cherry and Mint Chocolate Chip – both were absolutely delicious! The flavours were rich and refreshing, and the texture was just right. The shop was clean and tidy, and the staff were polite and friendly. A lovely experience overall – I’ll definitely come back for more!

google.author: Gurpz M
google.text: Best chippy in Llandudno but also one of the very best I've had in the UK. Made fresh with top quality chips. The batter on the fish was light but crispy and not too heavy. The perfect batter, highly recommend coming here.

google.author: Kristina Radoman
google.text: One of the best fish and chips we have ever had. It is crispy and fresh. We rarely leave a review but felt this was earned. The waitresses were really sweet.

google.author: Colin Dobbs
google.text: After visiting Llandudno for 6 years never been so after reading reviews we gave it a go so glad we did medium cod and chips twice great portions and plenty of chips fish was lovely and fresh tasting .batter light and crispy side order of curry sauce and mushy peas lovely will definitely. Be Popping in again when we visit Llandudno next year

google.author: Sarah Thornton
google.text: We loved our fish & chips today. My daughter actually said 'this is the best meal I have ever had in my life' .....can't get higher praise than that! Lovely friendly staff. Highly recommend. I cut a piece of the fish off for my son so it was actually bigger than in the photo! Also not all my chips were on the plate at the time!

google.author: AJ Castillo
google.text: The best Fish and Chips shop in Llandudno! Fresh, crispy and tasty food! Clean dining area and toilet. The 2 young lady servers today 20th July was very efficient, kind and always has smile on their faces. Highly recommended!!

google.author: Jay
google.text:
Never again. Be careful before ordering, otherwise you’ll end up with this kind of experience.

I ordered a doner & burger worth of £47 ) and there was no option whatsoever to choose sauce or salad on the system. I even have a screen recording to prove it. When I called the restaurant, the staff first insisted I had to select it. When I asked him to show me where, he changed his statement and said, “You have to write it if you need.”

On top of that, his attitude was incredibly rude — telling me “this is how people eat doner.” On what earth does a doner come without salad or sauce? Another staff member then shrugged it off saying “that’s past now, what do you want me to do, give you sauce and salad?”

I returned all the food, but still no customer service, no apology, nothing. If this is how you treat paying customers, then keep your rude attitude at home. Remember, we pay — that’s how your business runs.

google.author: Chris Etches
google.text: I asked for chips and cheese with extra cheese and garlic mayo. I paid for the extra cheese and the sauce is clearly burger sauce. Unfortunately I didn't check until I got home but I shouldn't have to. Such a simple order but clearly too difficult for the staff. I hope they can improve and learn send out basic orders soon without customers having to check.

google.author: Memphis Jones
google.text: Hadn't heard of the guys before, came to the rescue delivering my food close to 1am and it was incredible food, they didn't miss any of my requests for sauces/salt&vinegar either. Cheese was actually melted onto the chips which was perfect, burger was perfect and the stuffed crust pizza amazing also. Definitely ordering again

google.author: Donovan Sampson-Riggs

The owner I presume Zak is not the friendliest person but seemed to understand my allergy to seafood and fish but did not seem to be taking us seriously at first. The kebab was way better than expected and was  loaded with meat and salad and a wonderful tasting. We asked them to cut it in half a first for Zac. The fries were hot and crunchy. google.author: nanu sharma

google.author: Stephen Owen
google.text: Absolutely the best sandwich I’ve ever had, the ham was 10mm thick with 3 slices plus salad. All fresh and very tasty. You only get what you pay for and this food is the best in Llandudno.

google.author: Adrian Lee
google.text:
We fancied a coffee ☕  after a bit of shopping, we have passed this kiosk a few times.
I have to say this place serves the best coffee I have tasted I know it was from a machine like everywhere else but the taste was awesome.
We didn't have anything to eat but the rolls looked amazing roughly priced £4 to £5.
Definitely going back next time we are in Llandudno. Friendly lady that served  us

google.author: Paul Mooney
google.text: Fantastic  my wife had a black pudding and bacon bap great  selection will definitely go again

google.author: Howard Edmunds
google.text:
Wow what a find this has to be the best eatery in Llandudno. Fantastic selection of things to eat, nice and friendly staff .
Will definitely be back next time we’re in town.
Gary and Carol from Tredegar South Wales

google.author: Karen Williams
google.text: This is the most lovely sandwich bar, also sells pies, hot and cold drinks and the lady who works there is amazing. There are a couple of tables with chairs too, superb 👍

google.author: Dhibin Suresh
google.text: We tried the Zinger burger and popcorns, which were hot and spicy as described. The restaurant is clean—tables, floor, and toilets well maintained, bins cleared and not overflowing. Drinks come with unlimited refills. Perfect for a dine-in lunch and great value for money!

google.author: Brooklyn Turner
google.text: The burger was probably the best burger I’ve had at KFC in a long while, and in general the whole meal tbf.

google.author: Amanda Cory
google.text: Visited kfc llandudno and decided  to eat in for a change. The restaurant was clean and moderately busy, we ordered on self service and placed order to table. We had a lovely welcome and the same lady  (JANE) brought our food to the table, we chatted for about 5 mins and she was so friendly ,  i just didnt expect this level of service from a fast food restaurant. The food was hot, and tasty, love the seasoned fries.

google.author: Melissa Jayne Williams
google.text: I came in to KFC for my work break and didn't know what to order so I asked the staff there i believe her name is Mia, she was lovely very happy to help and gave good recommendations on what to order she also helped me with the order machine and had a lovely chat with me she is very smart and helpful and even answered any questions i had. thank you for the service will definitely be coming back

google.author: nidhin thomas
google.text: I tried Singapore fried rice, and it was good. They accept cash only, but bank transfers are available for transactions.

google.author: Thomas Barker
google.text: Best Chinese in Llandudno. Food and staff are amazing. Friendly and food tastes great.

google.author: Sharon Holmes
google.text:
We had a delivery tonight, first time as we are on holiday in the area. Although our delivery was quite late there was an event going on locally that affected traffic etc so, just one of those things really. When we rang to check staff were very polite and apologetic and the delivery driver was very friendly when he arrived.
The food was all really excellent, very reasonably priced, generous portions and delicious. Would highly recommend!

google.author: D - Wu
google.text:
Open late.
Food is authentic with reasonable price. Staff is friendly.

google.author: Lirio Hardy
google.text: we popped in here when every chippy nearby was closed and they offered us a 10% discount to get us to come in (it worked haha)! we got take out and it was so yummy and such big portions! extremely friendly and quick service, thank you so much!

google.author: Neil Dolan Dance
google.text:
The food was delicious 😋 and it was quick service, even though they were extremely busy. The only downside was the fact that you can only pay with cash. I had to go to the cash machine about 5mins away to take out cash and then go back, so that’s a bit annoying.
We had a few different dishes that we shared between us and they were all great. They only have a hygiene rate of a 4 which I think should be easy to improve on. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be going back again in the future.

google.author: John Charles
google.text:
Wanted fish & chips after all
Local ones had closed - The New Hong Kong Takeaway did not fail .
Food was cooked to order , served piping hot .
Staff were friendly and very welcoming , prices were comparable with the places , however the fish was delicious, and chips were great too.
Curry sauce and mushy peas were fantastic - best curry sauce I have had I many moons .

The menu board was filled with other delights and all looked very appetising .

The food we ordered was great and was still hot when we returned home .

google.author: L Fitzgerald
google.text: We were in Llandudundo for a walking holiday from Ireland and got this food as take away to our air BNB. It was honestly unbelievable. Chinese takeaway is a big thing back home in Ireland but I think this was the best one I've ever had. From the curry to the chips it was all top notch. It was a wonderful treat after a long day of hiking and I'd recommend this restaurant to anyone.

google.author: albert chan
google.text: The four of us ordered eight dishes in total, all of which were perfect, roast duck and prawn toast, Yang Chow fried rice, fried noodles with soy sauce, stir-fried mixed vegetables, spring rolls, fried meat, mixed meat in curry, and sweet and sour chicken. The portion was huge and we couldn't finish it.

google.author: Jose Gomez
google.text: We visited this New Hong Kong Take away as part of our staycation in Llandudno.  We we wre trying our luck by random search in Google,due to high rating, we decided to give it a go .however,  it was only few minutes of walking from our hotel,  so we decided to walk to the restaurant for a takeaway,  the staff was very professional and welcoming.    Even the local people in the restaurant were friendly and welcoming to tourists like us.    The food was really good and felt   authentic in taste. We ordered,  chicken and mushroom soup, beef in cashew curry,  a special fried rice,  and a beef fried rice.   All were very filling and tasty..    it costed us around 32 quid, which we felt reasonable for the quantity...  we highly recommend this Chinese restaurant to anyone looking for a chinese cusine in Llandudno..

name: Subway

google.author: A B
google.text: I don't mind a Subway from time to time and I've never had any issues at this branch.  There's a limited amount of indoor seating, which is very handy in Llandudno if you don't want your lunch to be stolen by a flying rat.

google.author: Joe W
google.text: Lovely food but not very clean great for food to go.

google.author: Janet Simon-Byrne
google.text:
Not sure what an earth has happened to this place but it was very disorganised, not much of the favourites on offer for fillings. Basically messy and dull, needed a clean.

Ordered for the kids tea but won't be going again. Normally the portions have been good but hardly anything on one sub. 2 tiny streaks of bacon, a slice of mozzarella and few cuts of lettuce. When I questioned it, the lad was not helpful or polite, just continued to make the sandwich. I would have walked if it wasn't for the kids looking forward to their subway treat.

No longer feeling the vibe as a long standing customer. Won't be coming back. Subway your people are letting you down. A very sad meal.

google.author: Chayanee Chimtakul
google.text:
I ordered lunch for me and my partner from  ‘Uber eat’ and when it comes, in the bag it has my partner food but they missed my sub so we phone them up but they won’t answer the call. My partner have a refund on Uber eat in 10 days but I still need my sub so we have to walk miles to get to SUBWAY…..

When we there I have talked to the manager and he make the sub and give cookies for free.

google.author: Gareth Bolton
google.text:
Place is a joke! Most of the staff are okay but managers pull them off service to sweep floors, prepare food they don’t need and get internet orders ready. They just don’t give a damn about the customer in the shop. Service is slow almost all the time. Went in once and there was a lovely cheerful lady on the counter and got served straight away, but it’s rare.
They also mix up orders so I hope you don’t have allergies!!!!

description: Casual counter-serve chain for build-your-own sandwiches & salads, with health-conscious options.

google.author: Saeed Tahir
google.text:
I'm giving 1 star review for below reasons:
- Lamb Chops in family platter were actually chewy mutton.
- Chicken kebabs had too much onion.
- Chips on the platter were burnt.
- Raita (yoghurt mint sauce) had too much water and when we asked for extra portion, they said it's finished.
- On the counter, it was mentioned to claim 10% discount by posting a review. However, they denied our request and said that we only give discount if there are 7 to 10 people who would individually review. Although I confronted that you're giving one bill (it was £86.95) and we can do individual reviews (4 adults). It was denied. This is totally misleading. When I asked for the owner, who was in front of me, the guy said that he's busy and can't come. When I insisted, he came and rudely said that what's the benefit for him if there are less than 7 or 10 reviews?

google.author: hina shehzad
google.text:
We visited this place in Llandudno and were so impressed! The food was absolutely delicious and 100% halal, which was a big plus. The atmosphere was really welcoming and comfortable, and you could tell the staff put their heart into everything they do. They were so hardworking, friendly, and supportive throughout our visit.

We actually went quite late at night and honestly didn’t expect much, but the service and quality turned out to be far better than we imagined. Definitely one of the best dining experiences we’ve had in Llandudno — highly recommended!

google.author: Asif Bulbulia
google.text: Absolutely delicious food, service is brilliant and the atmosphere is great very well presented and clean place. The food is made to how you like im quite a traveller and don't often write reviews but this place deserves the 5 stars ive given. Price is alot lower than most places nearby but this place doesn't scrimp on the brilliant and quality ingredients in their dishes. Thank you for hosting a tired and hungry traveller.

google.author: Shazia Iqbal
google.text:
We recently came to Llandudno for our little boys second birthday and being Muslim ourselves it was SO nice to see a halal restaurant in the area!
On the first night we ordered burgers to the hotel and this may be the best burger I've had! It was a really flavorful beef burger in a brioche bun and generally so delicious so we decided to eat at the restaurant the next day.
We ordered a platter and of course the burger again and everything was absolutely delicious.The atmosphere was lovely and the owner was very respectful Ma Sha Allah. Well done and thank you! : )

google.author: Muddasar Hussain
google.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
"Excellent food, very tasty! Everything was cooked perfectly and full of flavour. The staff were very friendly and the service was exceptional. Highly recommend The Big Mouth Grill!"

google.author: Eerie
google.text:
The pizza and garlic bread are always great, the doner is decent, and the speed at which they serve you is one of the best of any kebab shop. Additionally, it's possibly the cheapest kebab shop in the area. I've never been inside the building, so I don't know what the atmosphere is like, but the delivery service is always great.
However, the food can be very inconsistent (especially the fries and burgers). Sometimes it's good; but there have been times where I had green, slightly undercooked fries and a very sloppy, sickly burger with too much sauce. Overall, despite the inconsistency with the fries and burgers, this place is great for its quick service and great pizzas, so I would generally recommend it.

google.author: Nimans Tamang
google.text: Try to have good meal after long day snowdon hiking , and this what we received after paying 25£ in total tasteless pizza with 99% dough 1% toppings and that wasn’t good, southern fried chicken was even worse over fries in old oils and funky taste coming from chicken like expired or something. Burger and chips was decent but not worth literally bland food.

google.author: Atta Sohail
google.text: Was looking somewhere to have a quick take away. Got a larger mixed Kebab for £8. Absolutely amazing very tasty and quick service.

google.author: David Hayes (DHayes)
google.text:
Ordered a good £75 meal for the family tipped £5.

We did all manage to get something free we did not want "food poisoning"

I would not recommend this place even if I was dying on the side of the road

google.author: Sa P
google.text:
Had a 10" basic, chips and cheese and burger , what a treat it was. Reminding me of the old days.
Absolutely perfectly cooked, thank you for your service 🙏🏻

google.author: Ebrahim Vahed
google.text: Fresh fresh fresh. Scrumptious. Tasty. Great service and banter. Fully Halal. Generous portions. Enough for you is enough for two

google.author: Iqbal Mxd
google.text: Halal fish and chips. Excellent quality and service. Has about 6 tables to eat in. 10 mins walk from the beach. Fish and chips made fresh. Small and regular portions. Small suit children perfectly.

google.author: Mandy
google.text:
Went here today for some dinner, my husband ordered fish and chips, was lovely.
Very impressed with the food! Nicer fish than the pubs that charge you a lot for.
Would definitely go again .
Take no notice of the reviews , new owners not had it long but doing an amazing job.

google.author: Hanif Ur-Rehman
google.text: This is a great chip shop located near the Llududno pier. The food was very tasty and the portions were generous as well. A must for any fish and chips enthusiasts.

google.author: Robert Dyer
google.text: One of my favourite places for a classic meal of fish 'n' chips. Tasty batter, tasty cod and great chips. The only gripe is prices keep creeping up, but sadly it's probably just cost increases being passed on to the customers.

google.author: L S
google.text: Highly recommend checking this place out. Pizza and chips were tasty, freshly made and hot. Staff were lovely. Service was quick and the menu is extensive so there’s lots of options. The prices are good too, not too expensive but great value.

google.author: graham lee
google.text: The food we ordered was superb. The owner was very friendly and prepared the food quickly. We can't recommend highly enough.

google.author: Malavika Sreenivasan
google.text: I ordered a chicken kebab but it really wasn’t up to my expectations. The taste and quality didn’t match what I was hoping for.

google.author: Lisa Sleight
google.text: Absolutely prefect in all areas. Great burger perfectly served. Great fresh salad and just the right amount of mayonnaise! Highly recommend, if we lived here in Llandudno this would definitely be our regular take away. Next time we are here on holiday we'll definitely return. Thank you!

google.author: Ryan Kelly
google.text: Nice thin crispy crust pizza really enjoyed and the cheesy chips had plenty of cheese. Very friendly delivery driver thank you

google.author: Chris Wilson
google.text: Had a amazing stay at Craigside manor, loved every moment. Quality, modern, clean, and safe. Great location and enjoyed the walk to the front of Llandudno. Providing plenty of parking for guests was a huge bonus compared to other places in the area. Food was excellent, plenty of choice, arrived hot and quality ingredients, presentation was spot on, chips/fries came in metal pots that kept them warm for longer in your plate 😄 complements to the chef. The rooms are large enough, 4 in a room catered for, clean and comfortable, complementary hot chocolate and bottled water, TV, WiFi 6 was available in the rooms so kept the boys connected to there phones. Housekeeping was spot on, placed sign on door and they paid a visit some point during the day and provided us with clean towels. Definitely recommend this place for a weekend away and I look forward to visiting again in the year.

google.author: Jakki M
google.text: We live locally so had often passed this hotel and restaurant, but never called in. However, when we had to vacate our house overnight whilst having some building work done, this seemed the perfect solution. We called in for lunch, as we had to be out of our house early and the weather was not suitable for eating a sandwich on the promenade. The fixed price menu was excellent value and there was enough variety to make selection a pleasure. Service was very good. All of the staff were helpful and efficient. I was a bit paranoid about entering our car registration number to avoid a parking fine. I am conscious that I can easily make a mistake. After lunch we arranged to leave the car while we walked to the nearby Angel Bay to see the seals. We had to enter our car registration number again, but the waitress was helpful and patient with my fumbling. We checked in to a pleasant, spacious room facing the Little Orme. We were pleased to be able to open the window to get some fresh air, and even more pleased that the room had a fully working heating and air conditioning system, which we turned on when we closed the window. At night, with the window closed, it was blissfully silent, and we had an excellent night’s sleep in the very comfortable bed. The room had a good bathroom and there was plentiful hot water and a generous supply of toiletries. Our evening meal was delicious and fully include in our offer, with an extra £10 voucher covering a glass of wine. Breakfast was also very good, with a varied buffet and a good menu of cooked dishes. My poached eggs were perfectly cooked, which is definitely the measure of a skilled chef. Laura, the manager, took the time to have a chat with us and we felt very welcomed and well looked after. Thank you very much to all concerned.

google.author: Firm Button
google.text: Can’t complain about the service but will note some constructive feedback here. We had room 7, a family room that happened to be right above the hotel name sign so the room was light all night despite the light blocking curtains. Perhaps fit a light absorbing pelmet? That will certainly help if the underside of it absorbs light. Or turn the lights off after 11pm maybe? The shower had no hand shower, so not great for a good shower experience. The toilet flush buttons were hard to operate. But the room was well equipped with sockets and for charging devices. The breakfast was mediocre. The fried eggs overcooked, same with the poached eggs, the yellows were mostly firm. The hollandaise sauce was out of a packet and had an odd taste, so spoiled the eggs royal. Otherwise the breakfast was varied and decent, however I’d recommend semi skimmed milk as skimmed is like having water on your cereal lol but I asked for some cream to make some full fat and that was worked fine:-)

google.author: Connie Culmer
google.text: Absolutely beautiful service from Craigside Manor! We were an absolute nightmare from the moment we sat down, we asked to change seats and my partner is gluten intolerant but they were more than happy to accommodate us! 🥹 The food was outstanding and our servers, Laura and Sion, were extremely friendly and welcoming; Sion even going above and beyond at the end of the meal to find me a peppermint tea! A beautiful dinner to end a beautiful stay in Llandudno, could not recommend this place more! We will be back, maybe even to stay next time! An absolute gem 💎

google.author: Jules Arends
google.text:
We stayed in the accessible room as I am unable to do stairs and get into a bath for a shower.I am sure there are more suitable customers for this room than me,but as it's the only downstairs room with a wet room I needed to use it.
I have wanted to book here for a while but it has never been available.Maybe they should consider putting in more downstairs rooms for less able customers.
The hotel has a lovely feel to it and it's position on the top of the hill is very scenic.It would be lovely to sit outside with a drink in the warmer weather. The food is also very good and their Fixe Prix menu is great value.
You could walk into Llandudno if you are able,or drive and park up for a few hours for free at the retail parks.You can also park all day on the prom for £4.50,which is free after 4pm.
We love Llandudno and visit regularly,staying at The Craigside Manor was a treat we would recommend.

google.author: Marc Drye
google.text:
I think they deserve full stars, we enjoyed our breakfast here, the staff were lovely and friendly and helpful.
The food was nice.
It's a tiny little cafe so only a few tables inside, snug might be the polite word.
I had the breakfast, with also a homemade scone with cream and jam. That was very crumbly but it was homemade and not shop bought so it was very tasty.
Breakfast was perfect.

I only have one complaint, they only do a very very small breakfast.
One sausage, two bacon, one egg, half of a tomato and spoonful of beans in a seperate dish. And you only get one slice of toast.

There should be options for larger breakfasts, as I usually have 3 or 4 of everything and I didn't ask for this as I can imagine as I was paying around 8.50 for the standard breakfast, I'm guessing the price would have doubled or trebled or more.

Fried bread would gave been nice too.

But still gets 5 stars because it was a lovely little cafe ran by nice people and they're providing a good service and I can't complain as the food was spot on.

google.author: Laura Edwards
google.text:
Breakfast is the best breakfast I’ve had in a long time. The black pudding was delicious, eggs cooked perfectly, everything was delicious. We will be returning before we go home!!

Lovely, lovely food.

google.author: BIG Kev G
google.text: Nice place, nice decor  ! But the staff behind the counter wasn't very happy. Even less happy when I asked for a breakfast, but they don't do them in the afternoons so I was gutted. I can't comment on the food as I didn't have any.

google.author: Ae Cn
google.text: The Cafe's staff are friendly, and the food offers excellent value for money. It comes highly recommended.

google.author: chaitanya kabadi
google.text: Really nice little spot to chill and grab a bite. The coffee was great—had both a cappuccino and a latte, and they were smooth and tasty. The burger was simple but fresh, and the chocolate cake was super rich and gooey—so good! Service was quick, and the vibe was relaxed. Would totally come back.

name: The Resident Covent Garden

google.author: Justin Merritt
google.text: Great hotel (amazing value for the money in a wonderful location) with incredible service. My wife got sick during our stay and they went above and beyond to assist us. Jackie and Graeme are awesome!! I just wish we had this level of service in the States. Stay here - there is a reason that this hotel is ranked so highly.

google.author: TipTop 79!
google.text: What a wonderful hotel with impeccable personal service. These guys go above and beyond to ensure you have a wonderful stay. We are 3 friends celebrating a 50th birthday. We were asked if a special occasion and shared why we were staying. We were kindly gifted a bottle of wine, some balloons in the room and lovely hand written personal card. The room had everything we could have needed, slippers, ghd hairdryer, mini kitchen and a powerful shower - an absolute must! This will be our go to hotel for future visits.

google.author: Sonoma Cartwright
google.text: We couldn't fault this hotel. Perfect location. We had a nice big room which was lovely and quiet, even from the noise outside and very clean.The bed was really comfy. The 4 staff we dealt with were all very helpful and friendly. I would definitely recommend this hotel and will be back again.

google.author: E
google.text:
EXCEPTIONAL hotel! My go-to in London. While location is unbeatable, the stand-out must be the service. The reception always makes you feel like family. The warm and genuine interactions is a reflection of the kind of teamwork they have. It plays a large part in what makes the hotel what it is.
Room cleanliness is also pristine and rooms decently sized.
There really is no other better place than this to stay in London.

google.author: Maritza Melania Lacayo
google.text:
I stayed at The Resident Covent Garden from January 5 to January 11, 2026. I took my mother on a mother-daughter trip to London and I could not have made a better choice in terms of the hotel! The staff is absolutely incredible. They are friendly, kind, helpful, and genuine. We arrived after having had our flights delayed and cancelled for over 14 hours and when we arrived to the hotel, we told them the whole ordeal and they sent a bottle of prosecco up to the room! They showed us some of the in-room amenities, and even helped us bring our bags upstairs. After such a long and difficult travel adventure, this was so appreciated!

The next day, we met more of the wonderful staff, and they were always happy to assist with directions, recommendations, and any other questions we had. Jacky, The Resident foodie, was the go-to person for restaurant recommendations! What a pleasure it was to come back to the hotel and tell her what a great meal we had at a place she recommended. I also woke up feeling a bit under the weather on our third day and when I briefly mentioned this to the team member over the phone in the morning, she brought up a teapot with some wonderful ginger tea. It was such a kind gesture, I'll never forget it.

Another wonderful tradition is that there are drinks served in the lobby every night between 6 and 7pm! It was a great way to meet other guests, talk to the staff, and plan the rest of our evening. What a treat!

The rooms were impeccably clean, modern, and comfortable. The location could not have been better. We were about a 3 minute walk from Covent Garden, a 5 minute walk to Trafalgar Square, and extremely well connected in terms of the tube and bus stations. There are wonderful restaurants all around, a great lively energy, and plenty to do! If you're looking to stay in London for a few days and need a comfortable, friendly, and perfectly situated place to stay, look no further than The Resident Covent Garden. I thank them kindly for treating us so well! They were an integral part of making my mom's birthday trip so special and I am forever grateful.

google.author: Ladies That Lunch in Style
google.text:
Llandudno Esplanade Hotel on the prom opposite Llandudno Pier.
Huge refurb on the hotel. How did we not know about this fabulous restaurant. Absolutely 10/10👜 handbag restaurant review. Compliments to the chef Jason Hughes featured on Great British Menu. WOW to the menu and all the delicious flavours. We tried the festive lunch menu (only £2 extra for the three course so why not 🥳) Festive dinner menu looked good too 👏. Love the presentation. Love the atmosphere. Love the decor in here. Everywhere is immaculate even the kitchen 5 hygiene rating 👏. Uniformed well trained staff. Front of house Gareth what a welcome and very informative. We also heard how you greeted others and treated everyone the same. Wish all maitre d hosted as good as you. Highly recommend you try here. We parked in the shopping centre multi story car park. Some parking available on the prom.

google.author: Phillip Wicks
google.text:
Goat is one of my favourite restaurants. The venues is beautifully designed and decorated. The staff were all warm and welcoming, the food is absolutely delicious.
I had a Welsh onion Soup followed soup, Beef shin with goose fat roasted potatoes and then a Burnt Welsh cream pudding. All the meals were so tasty and wonderfully presented. I would highly recommend this venue.

google.author: Rebecca Banks
google.text: Fantastic time at The Goat - HIGHLY RECOMMEND! When you step into The Goat you feel like you are in a swanky restaurant in a city, I can not believe I have not visited this place before, it is just stunning! The food was so delicious, some of the best food we have had in a long time. The service was great and the staff were really friendly. The decor is just stunning with impeccable attention to detail. I can not wait to visit The Goat again.

google.author: Valerie Dell
google.text: Gorgeous venue. Fabulous food, compliments to the chefs. Amazing French onion soup follows by Turkey for me, my husband had the beef & just wow 🤩 A taste sensation. Fabulous Aperol spritz as well. Attentive yet discreet service. Highly recommend

google.author: Dan
google.text:
Popped hear with friends and my god son for a breakfast with santa. A really good experience and the breakfast was amazing. The staff are lovely and chatty. We got to meet santa after our food, which was a great touch for the little one.
Highly recommended taking you little ones to see santa and get a breakfast to.
